_meta.note: 只需填 dst。src 內的材質包圖示與數字已在抽取階段排除。

724b41386b57.src: A01 welded its chamber shut on the first shot. A05 kept launching the trigger instead of the shell. A11 launched both. When the A16 finally sent the ammo where you aimed it, the lead Corkian engineer wept, stamped "APPROVED" on the paperwork, and handed the blueprint to the Factory.
724b41386b57.dst: A01 在第一發就把砲膛給焊死了。A05 老是把扳機而不是砲彈射出去。A11 兩個都射。等到 A16 終於把彈藥送到你瞄準的地方時，Corkian 的首席工程師哭了出來，在文件上蓋了「核准」，把藍圖交給了工廠。
724b41386b57.flat: A01 welded its chamber shut on the first shot. A05 kept launching the trigger instead of the shell. A11 launched both. When the A16 finally sent the ammo where you aimed it, the lead Corkian engineer wept, stamped "APPROVED" on the paperwork, and handed the blueprint to the Factory.
724b41386b57._raw: A01 welded its chamber shut on the first shot. A05 kept launching the trigger instead of the shell. A11 launched both. When the A16 finally sent the ammo where you aimed it, the lead Corkian engineer wept, stamped "APPROVED" on the paperwork, and handed the blueprint to the Factory.

f215b3296b36.src: The last of her crimes was against herself. She reviled and hated, shattering any glass in which she might see her own cruel visage.
f215b3296b36.dst: 她最後一樁罪行是對著自己。她鄙夷、她憎恨，砸碎每一面可能照見自己殘酷面容的鏡子。
f215b3296b36.flat: The last of her crimes was against herself. She reviled and hated, shattering any glass in which she might see her own cruel visage.

49d4bd10a516.src: "Those bloody zombies don't kip down at night, what makes you think a curfew might bally-well help?" -General Graken, {p} Militia
49d4bd10a516.dst: 「那些該死的殭屍晚上又不睡覺，你憑什麼覺得宵禁會有屁用？」—General Graken，{p} 民兵
49d4bd10a516.flat: "Those bloody zombies don't kip down at night, what makes you think a curfew might bally-well help?" -General Graken, {p} Militia
49d4bd10a516._raw: "Those bloody zombies don't kip down at night, what makes you think a curfew might bally-well help?" -General Graken, Nemract Militia

60dc5cb6e962.src: A deep regret stains this weapon-once a healing implement of the scholar-priest, its gentle power was turned and twisted as his ideals and resolve were tested, and faltered. With its wielder long passed, perhaps it can finally be absolved of the atrocities committed by his hand... and remember the peace it has long forgotten.
60dc5cb6e962.dst: 這件武器上沾著深深的悔恨。它曾是那位學者祭司手中的療癒之器，而當他的理想與意志受到考驗、終於動搖時，那份溫和的力量也被扭轉、被撕裂。如今持有者早已作古，或許它終能為那雙手所犯下的暴行得到赦免……也終能想起它遺忘已久的安寧。
60dc5cb6e962.flat: A deep regret stains this weapon-once a healing implement of the scholar-priest, its gentle power was turned and twisted as his ideals and resolve were tested, and faltered. With its wielder long passed, perhaps it can finally be absolved of the atrocities committed by his hand... and remember the peace it has long forgotten.

5e38269d7084.src: The depths bring stability, order, security. Those above are weak, unable to withstand the pressure. Those below are concerned with what lies further down. Leave your lawlessness, your chaos, your delusions of freedom. Open yourself to the abyss.
5e38269d7084.dst: 深處帶來的是穩定、秩序、安全。上面那些人是弱者，承受不了壓力。下面那些人則只在意更深處有什麼。放下你的無法無天、你的混亂、你對自由的妄想。向深淵敞開自己。
5e38269d7084.flat: The depths bring stability, order, security. Those above are weak, unable to withstand the pressure. Those below are concerned with what lies further down. Leave your lawlessness, your chaos, your delusions of freedom. Open yourself to the abyss.

f3b684f7e1de.src: This item was named by someone from the community!
f3b684f7e1de.dst: 這件物品的名字是由社群的某個人取的！
f3b684f7e1de.flat: This item was named by someone from the community!

9dfd4d45d069.src: This wand is capable of attacks so fast that it appears to flicker in and out of existence. Anyone able to access its full potential will be seen as only a blur to their enemies.
9dfd4d45d069.dst: 這根魔杖的攻擊快到會讓它看起來在存在與不存在之間閃爍。任何能發揮它全部潛力的人，在敵人眼中都只會是一道殘影。
9dfd4d45d069.flat: This wand is capable of attacks so fast that it appears to flicker in and out of existence. Anyone able to access its full potential will be seen as only a blur to their enemies.

e413bddfa9f1.src: The Fracturing brought Ahms into a shattered sky, sundering cliffs into an archipelago against the void. The tremors that linger carry an ancient power, bringing mountains to heel with ease and leaving devastation in its wake.
e413bddfa9f1.dst: 「碎裂」把 Ahms 推上了破碎的天空，將崖壁撕成一片懸於虛空之上的群島。至今未散的震顫承載著一股遠古之力，能輕易使群山俯首，並在所過之處留下滿目瘡痍。
e413bddfa9f1.flat: The Fracturing brought Ahms into a shattered sky, sundering cliffs into an archipelago against the void. The tremors that linger carry an ancient power, bringing mountains to heel with ease and leaving devastation in its wake.

3bbebb1a196b.src: This bloody palette knife was used to kill only two people before it was abandoned - a killer who broke into a great artist's home, and the artist who struck the blow.
3bbebb1a196b.dst: 這把染血的畫刀在被丟棄之前只殺過兩個人——一個是闖進偉大畫家家中的兇手，另一個，是揮出那一刀的畫家。
3bbebb1a196b.flat: This bloody palette knife was used to kill only two people before it was abandoned - a killer who broke into a great artist's home, and the artist who struck the blow.

885106374f95.src: Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and raw potential fuse to create an imposing presence, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for complete obliteration.
885106374f95.dst: 銘刻的 Uth 符文之力與原始的潛能交融，形成一種壓迫性的存在感；這件武器不過是使用者「徹底毀滅」這份意志在現實中的延伸。
885106374f95.flat: Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and raw potential fuse to create an imposing presence, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for complete obliteration.

b76e0c8089d8.src: Soul-locking magic is one outlawed by Gavellian governments, only used by the most insidious and cruel of mages. One such enchantment looms dormant in this mundane-looking maul. Continued usage of the weapon threatens to release it upon the wielder, permanently binding them to the weapon.
b76e0c8089d8.dst: 鎖魂魔法是 Gavel 各國政府明令禁止的，只有最陰險殘忍的法師才會用。這把外表平凡的巨槌裡，就潛伏著一道這樣的咒法。持續使用它，那道咒法隨時可能反噬持有者，把他永遠束縛在這把武器上。
b76e0c8089d8.flat: Soul-locking magic is one outlawed by Gavellian governments, only used by the most insidious and cruel of mages. One such enchantment looms dormant in this mundane-looking maul. Continued usage of the weapon threatens to release it upon the wielder, permanently binding them to the weapon.

8b83351ebdea.src: There's an inscription written hastily lining the edge of the blade: "Before it is over, I will see you again... but I have been called. And I must answer."
8b83351ebdea.dst: 刃緣上匆匆刻著一段話：「在這一切結束之前，我會再見到你……但我被召喚了。我必須回應。」
8b83351ebdea.flat: There's an inscription written hastily lining the edge of the blade: "Before it is over, I will see you again... but I have been called. And I must answer."

9ac284e60180.src: The reigning king of thieves in {p}'s underworld would brandish this golden dagger to his enemies so fast, you wouldn't even realise your wallet was now missing.
9ac284e60180.dst: {p} 地下世界的盜賊之王會把這柄金匕首朝敵人揮出去，快到你連錢包不見了都還沒發覺。
9ac284e60180.flat: The reigning king of thieves in {p}'s underworld would brandish this golden dagger to his enemies so fast, you wouldn't even realise your wallet was now missing.
9ac284e60180._raw: The reigning king of thieves in Almuj's underworld would brandish this golden dagger to his enemies so fast, you wouldn't even realise your wallet was now missing.

6958bb0ecf64.src: Legends whisper of an incredible blade, that ripples the ground and shatters the tide. Formed from the waves of the sea, it's said all who wield it are untouchable. This, however... appears to just be a regular old pen?
6958bb0ecf64.dst: 傳說低聲流傳著一把不可思議的刃，它能撼動大地、粉碎潮汐。據說它由海浪凝成，持有它的人皆不可觸犯。然而這一把……看起來就只是一支普通的舊筆？
6958bb0ecf64.flat: Legends whisper of an incredible blade, that ripples the ground and shatters the tide. Formed from the waves of the sea, it's said all who wield it are untouchable. This, however... appears to just be a regular old pen?

6ac1dcf92978.src: It is thought that this primitive wand was used by early man to create the first spells. It is made from a wood that no longer exists.
6ac1dcf92978.dst: 一般認為這根原始的魔杖是早期人類用來創造最初法術的工具。它的木料來自一種已經不存在的樹。
6ac1dcf92978.flat: It is thought that this primitive wand was used by early man to create the first spells. It is made from a wood that no longer exists.

92cea0ba305f.src: Let its whispers guide your hand, and let nothing but a scar of resentment remain.
92cea0ba305f.dst: 讓它的低語引導你的手，除了一道怨恨的疤之外什麼都不要留下。
92cea0ba305f.flat: Let its whispers guide your hand, and let nothing but a scar of resentment remain.

4da0be4b7ddb.src: To forge a weapon such as this from the cursed lava of the portal basin requires dozens, for each smith would lose themselves to the force of corruption before it is finished. The nightmarishly hooked blade serves no purpose but destruction, as intended.
4da0be4b7ddb.dst: 要用傳送門盆地的受詛熔岩鍛出這樣一把武器，得要數十名鐵匠——因為每一個都會在完工之前先失去自我，被腐化之力吞沒。這柄惡夢般的鉤形刀刃除了破壞之外別無用途，而那正是它被造出來的目的。
4da0be4b7ddb.flat: To forge a weapon such as this from the cursed lava of the portal basin requires dozens, for each smith would lose themselves to the force of corruption before it is finished. The nightmarishly hooked blade serves no purpose but destruction, as intended.

2a623029ff51.src: Under the waters, between the waves, there lies something-something beautiful.
2a623029ff51.dst: 在水面之下，在浪與浪之間，躺著某個東西——某個很美的東西。
2a623029ff51.flat: Under the waters, between the waves, there lies something-something beautiful.

139f333286f0.src: The power of the unknown. The mysteries hidden in dark corners, between the walls; the forgotten poems, the renounced names, the words spoken into the abyss and never heard again. Meld them, wield them; they are yours to command.
139f333286f0.dst: 未知之力。藏在陰暗角落與牆壁夾縫裡的謎；被遺忘的詩、被棄用的名字、那些說進深淵之後再也沒被聽見的話語。把它們熔在一起，握在手裡；它們從此聽你差遣。
139f333286f0.flat: The power of the unknown. The mysteries hidden in dark corners, between the walls; the forgotten poems, the renounced names, the words spoken into the abyss and never heard again. Meld them, wield them; they are yours to command.

91e68cb692ec.src: Originally intended for a more benign purpose, this piece of royal technology has been repurposed by something with far more malicious intentions. Despite the electrified water spraying from it, the smell of death never seems to wash away.
91e68cb692ec.dst: 這件皇家科技原本是為了更良善的用途而造，如今卻被某種懷有惡意得多的東西改作他用。儘管帶電的水不斷從中噴出，那股死亡的氣味卻怎麼也沖不掉。
91e68cb692ec.flat: Originally intended for a more benign purpose, this piece of royal technology has been repurposed by something with far more malicious intentions. Despite the electrified water spraying from it, the smell of death never seems to wash away.

6e6117970163.src: The unwieldy, yet imposing stature of this massive sickle strikes awe into those who view it. Those who have the will to wield it, however, seem to garner respect from all those around them, as though they had become a god.
6e6117970163.dst: 這把巨大鐮刀笨重卻威儀逼人，見者無不心生敬畏。而那些有意志駕馭它的人，似乎能贏得周遭所有人的尊崇——彷彿他們已然成神。
6e6117970163.flat: The unwieldy, yet imposing stature of this massive sickle strikes awe into those who view it. Those who have the will to wield it, however, seem to garner respect from all those around them, as though they had become a god.

b20ae7e984c6.src: Allies are exhausting, with their egos and beliefs, and pesky moral codes. Followers are much better-soldiers in your own perfect image, whose deaths are merely scaffolds to a world of your design.
b20ae7e984c6.dst: 同伴令人疲憊：他們有自尊、有信念，還有礙事的道德。追隨者要好得多——那是照著你自己的完美形象打造的兵卒，他們的死不過是通往你所設計的世界的鷹架。
b20ae7e984c6.flat: Allies are exhausting, with their egos and beliefs, and pesky moral codes. Followers are much better-soldiers in your own perfect image, whose deaths are merely scaffolds to a world of your design.

0efad019f61f.src: Stories say that should anyone wield both of these fearsome gauntlets in battle, they will become unkillable in a fight. The second gauntlet, however, has never been found.
0efad019f61f.dst: 傳說只要有人在戰鬥中同時戴上這兩只可怖的護手，他就會變得不死之身。不過另一只護手，至今從未被找到。
0efad019f61f.flat: Stories say that should anyone wield both of these fearsome gauntlets in battle, they will become unkillable in a fight. The second gauntlet, however, has never been found.

7018867e2d77.src: There is very little outside the purview of those with power. No matter the circumstance, those in a higher position can, will, and have justified their actions in different ways. Some reasons are fine, some are weak. But what sort of justification is there, for those in the highest position? You have the floor.
7018867e2d77.dst: 對握有權力的人而言，幾乎沒有什麼是管不到的。無論處境如何，位高者總能、也總會、也確實用各種方式為自己的行為找到說法。有些理由站得住腳，有些薄弱得可笑。但站在最高處的那個人，又需要什麼樣的辯解呢？請說吧，現在輪到你了。
7018867e2d77.flat: There is very little outside the purview of those with power. No matter the circumstance, those in a higher position can, will, and have justified their actions in different ways. Some reasons are fine, some are weak. But what sort of justification is there, for those in the highest position? You have the floor.

4609b6903fa9.dst: 跑得比他們快。想得比他們遠。撐得比他們久。

b2eacd68b08e.src: Weightless as a fallen feather, yet lethal as a hawk’s descent. Its beveled edge reshapes the slipstream to cradle your form, tugging you through the air as you deliver strike after strike, movements blurring into a flurry of beating wings.
b2eacd68b08e.dst: 輕若一片落羽，卻致命如鷹隼俯衝。它的斜刃會重塑氣流來托住你的身形，在你一擊接一擊之際把你拽過空中，動作模糊成一陣振翅。
b2eacd68b08e.flat: Weightless as a fallen feather, yet lethal as a hawk’s descent. Its beveled edge reshapes the slipstream to cradle your form, tugging you through the air as you deliver strike after strike, movements blurring into a flurry of beating wings.

89183047e0fa.src: Let the land before you serve as the script for your words to write anew.
89183047e0fa.dst: 讓你面前的這片土地，成為你重新書寫的稿紙。
89183047e0fa.flat: Let the land before you serve as the script for your words to write anew.

eeb237c4e97d.src: Mysterious runes, held by inexplicable ancient guardians, were once moulded together for study purposes. The experiment went awry, as the runic words Nii, Az, and Ek were combined in a reaction that resulted in the collapse of a civilization.
eeb237c4e97d.dst: 那些由不可名狀的遠古守衛所持有的神祕符文，曾為了研究而被鑄在一起。實驗失控了——Nii、Az、Ek 這三個符文之詞交會，引發的反應終結了一整個文明。
eeb237c4e97d.flat: Mysterious runes, held by inexplicable ancient guardians, were once moulded together for study purposes. The experiment went awry, as the runic words Nii, Az, and Ek were combined in a reaction that resulted in the collapse of a civilization.

a47b9e8c1640.src: Carrying this hefty staff, you feel a sense of security and emboldenment. Its protective powers ensure you stay far out of the grasping undeads' reach.
a47b9e8c1640.dst: 拿著這根沉重的長杖，你會生出一股安全與底氣。它的守護之力確保你始終待在那些伸手抓取的亡者觸及不到的地方。
a47b9e8c1640.flat: Carrying this hefty staff, you feel a sense of security and emboldenment. Its protective powers ensure you stay far out of the grasping undeads' reach.

9c4dba34e65f.src: The show is about to begin.
9c4dba34e65f.flat: The show is about to begin.

b9b3b3fd9989.src: Stone shorn from mountains by the roiling sea gathered on the shores of {p} one day, washed onto the sand in the shape of a massive spear. It was taken as an omen, and the stones were forged into a true weapon.
b9b3b3fd9989.dst: 有一天，被翻騰海浪從山上削下的石頭聚集在 {p} 的岸邊，以一柄巨矛的形狀被沖上沙灘。人們把它視為預兆，於是那些石頭被鍛成了一件真正的武器。
b9b3b3fd9989.flat: Stone shorn from mountains by the roiling sea gathered on the shores of {p} one day, washed onto the sand in the shape of a massive spear. It was taken as an omen, and the stones were forged into a true weapon.
b9b3b3fd9989._raw: Stone shorn from mountains by the roiling sea gathered on the shores of Llevigar one day, washed onto the sand in the shape of a massive spear. It was taken as an omen, and the stones were forged into a true weapon.

9580b629655c.src: Archers have often experimented with tipped arrows. Launching the substance itself, however, is an innovation. A viscous ooze corrosive to anything it touches, it remains to be seen if their remains will be seen.
9580b629655c.dst: 弓手一直在試各種塗了東西的箭。但把那個東西本身射出去，是個創舉。一種黏稠的濃漿，觸到什麼就腐蝕什麼；至於他們的遺體還看不看得到，就不好說了。
9580b629655c.flat: Archers have often experimented with tipped arrows. Launching the substance itself, however, is an innovation. A viscous ooze corrosive to anything it touches, it remains to be seen if their remains will be seen.

c98528cd417d.src: An extremely rare metallic ore only found within the island region of Corkus, it is normally used in decorative dyes. However, a mishap one day caused the discovery of strange and cumulative effects when exposed to traditional magicks.
c98528cd417d.dst: 一種極為稀有的金屬礦，只在 Corkus 島區出產，通常用於裝飾性染料。然而某天的一場意外，讓人發現它接觸傳統魔法時會產生奇異且會累積的效應。
c98528cd417d.flat: An extremely rare metallic ore only found within the island region of Corkus, it is normally used in decorative dyes. However, a mishap one day caused the discovery of strange and cumulative effects when exposed to traditional magicks.

54f2a207247a.src: Hewn from the great obsidian spires surrounding the massive Nether gate, this fiercely-hooked dagger absorbs light and magic energy alike to create a desolate void wherever it is wielded.
54f2a207247a.dst: 從環繞著巨大下界之門的黑曜石尖塔上鑿下，這柄鉤刺猙獰的匕首會同時吸走光與魔力，讓它所到之處化為一片荒蕪的虛空。
54f2a207247a.flat: Hewn from the great obsidian spires surrounding the massive Nether gate, this fiercely-hooked dagger absorbs light and magic energy alike to create a desolate void wherever it is wielded.

55d4b6a7d98e.src: The creator of this polished white blade insists that its true power will never be unlocked, for only those who are not influenced by the elements of the world know truly how to utilize it.
55d4b6a7d98e.dst: 這把打磨過的白刃，其創造者堅稱它真正的力量永遠不會被解放；因為唯有不受世間元素影響的人，才真正懂得如何駕馭它。
55d4b6a7d98e.flat: The creator of this polished white blade insists that its true power will never be unlocked, for only those who are not influenced by the elements of the world know truly how to utilize it.

e95bfb83b556.src: The fabled weapon of the titular dark Assassin, the blade's small stature hides its true powers. Shadows undulate about the hilt.
e95bfb83b556.dst: 那位以「暗影」為名的刺客所持的傳說武器，刃身短小的外表掩蓋了它真正的力量。陰影在劍柄周圍起伏不定。
e95bfb83b556.flat: The fabled weapon of the titular dark Assassin, the blade's small stature hides its true powers. Shadows undulate about the hilt.

7b08987a2ccc.src: One who forsook all others in pursuit of their own gain forced an extension of their own will into existence. This culmination of that will consumes all it touches.
7b08987a2ccc.dst: 某個為了一己之利而捨棄一切他人的人，硬是把自身意志的延伸推進了現實。那份意志的極致成果，會吞噬它所觸及的一切。
7b08987a2ccc.flat: One who forsook all others in pursuit of their own gain forced an extension of their own will into existence. This culmination of that will consumes all it touches.

d23aad484b13.src: Your saviour is not coming.It's pulling towards something.
d23aad484b13.dst: 你的救主不會來了。它正被某種東西牽引著。
d23aad484b13.flat: Your saviour is not coming.It's pulling towards something.

28468361b0de.src: Blood. Carnage. Death. Destruction. This is all Annihilation knows. A fury written into its very core, a violent rage building from an endless War. If it were to have its way, all of Wynn would fall to chaos.
28468361b0de.dst: 血。殺戮。死亡。毀滅。這就是 Annihilation 所知的一切。那份狂怒寫進了它的核心，是一場無盡戰爭所堆積出來的暴烈。若讓它得逞，整個 Wynn 都會墜入混沌。
28468361b0de.flat: Blood. Carnage. Death. Destruction. This is all Annihilation knows. A fury written into its very core, a violent rage building from an endless War. If it were to have its way, all of Wynn would fall to chaos.

426da905f4f1.src: And as the spring bursts, the blossom petals flutter in the wind amongst the ashes of your enemies.
426da905f4f1.dst: 而當春天綻開，花瓣便在你敵人的灰燼之間隨風翻飛。
426da905f4f1.flat: And as the spring bursts, the blossom petals flutter in the wind amongst the ashes of your enemies.

f6f140d396c8.src: A mystical sapling native to the shores of {p} has been fashioned into this simple staff. Even uprooted, you notice its continuous growth.
f6f140d396c8.dst: 一株原生於 {p} 岸邊的神祕樹苗被削成了這根樸素的長杖。即使已經被連根拔起，你仍會注意到它從未停止生長。
f6f140d396c8.flat: A mystical sapling native to the shores of {p} has been fashioned into this simple staff. Even uprooted, you notice its continuous growth.
f6f140d396c8._raw: A mystical sapling native to the shores of Mage Island has been fashioned into this simple staff. Even uprooted, you notice its continuous growth.

9220d468eb7a.src: Forged from the fang of a ferocious beast. Despite its small size, it can land blows at considerable range.
9220d468eb7a.dst: 以一頭凶猛野獸的獠牙鍛成。儘管體積不大，它卻能在相當遠的距離上造成打擊。
9220d468eb7a.flat: Forged from the fang of a ferocious beast. Despite its small size, it can land blows at considerable range.

1038dd4dc7e2.src: It looks like they spelled the name wrong...
1038dd4dc7e2.dst: 看樣子他們把名字拼錯了……
1038dd4dc7e2.flat: It looks like they spelled the name wrong...

abbc4b736383.src: Crafted from Mandragora roots and adorned with decorative wreaths of Elven pines, these wands are utilized in {p}'s solstice festivals to celebrate each passing year of Villager and Elven comradery.
abbc4b736383.dst: 以曼德拉草根製成，綴上精靈松枝編的裝飾花環，這類法杖用於 {p} 的至日慶典，慶祝村民與精靈又共處了一年。
abbc4b736383.flat: Crafted from Mandragora roots and adorned with decorative wreaths of Elven pines, these wands are utilized in {p}'s solstice festivals to celebrate each passing year of Villager and Elven comradery.
abbc4b736383._raw: Crafted from Mandragora roots and adorned with decorative wreaths of Elven pines, these wands are utilized in Efilim's solstice festivals to celebrate each passing year of Villager and Elven comradery.

ac32b2a287ff.src: Seems like the name is misspelled a little bit.
ac32b2a287ff.dst: 這名字好像有一點拼錯了。
ac32b2a287ff.flat: Seems like the name is misspelled a little bit.

77eba03b5175.src: Beauty and fragility go hand in hand. As nature's blossoms and branches are delightful, so are they delicate. A single spark can set the whole world into glorious blaze.
77eba03b5175.dst: 美麗與脆弱總是相伴而行。自然的花與枝令人愉悅，同時也纖弱易折。一星火花，就足以讓整個世界陷入壯麗的燃燒。
77eba03b5175.flat: Beauty and fragility go hand in hand. As nature's blossoms and branches are delightful, so are they delicate. A single spark can set the whole world into glorious blaze.

17581d1473ad.src: Built by Cerid to accrue raw static charge from the surroundings and direct it at opponents, the blade's chief failing is that the wielder is not rendered immune to their own discharge as intended.
17581d1473ad.dst: Cerid 打造它是為了從周遭汲取原始靜電並導向對手；而這把刃最主要的失敗之處在於，持有者並不像原本設想的那樣、對自己放出的電免疫。
17581d1473ad.flat: Built by Cerid to accrue raw static charge from the surroundings and direct it at opponents, the blade's chief failing is that the wielder is not rendered immune to their own discharge as intended.

49e0714eaf1a.src: The frozen drops lashing your skin. The roar of the wind filling your ears. You've mastered it all. You can shape the winds, direct the rain. You are the storm.
49e0714eaf1a.dst: 冰凍的水滴抽打著你的皮膚。狂風的怒吼灌滿你的耳朵。這一切你都已經掌握。你能塑造風、指揮雨。你就是那場風暴。
49e0714eaf1a.flat: The frozen drops lashing your skin. The roar of the wind filling your ears. You've mastered it all. You can shape the winds, direct the rain. You are the storm.

bdb7ae60334b.src: A blade of pure light forms in your hands. It moves of its own accord, a blinding radiance dancing through your enemies, using you as a vessel for its brilliance.
bdb7ae60334b.dst: 一柄由純粹光芒構成的刃在你手中成形。它會自行移動，化作一道刺目的光輝在你的敵人之間起舞，以你為器皿展現它的燦爛。
bdb7ae60334b.flat: A blade of pure light forms in your hands. It moves of its own accord, a blinding radiance dancing through your enemies, using you as a vessel for its brilliance.

a99b7cbdf1a9.src: The storm is a wicked beast, built of buffeting gales and electric agony. But at the very heart of the tempest lies a sanctuary, a blink of respite, where the waves run radiant in every hue.
a99b7cbdf1a9.dst: 風暴是一頭邪惡的野獸，由狂襲的疾風與電擊的苦痛所構成。但在這場暴風的正中心有一處聖域，一瞬的喘息，那裡的浪以各種色彩熠熠生輝。
a99b7cbdf1a9.flat: The storm is a wicked beast, built of buffeting gales and electric agony. But at the very heart of the tempest lies a sanctuary, a blink of respite, where the waves run radiant in every hue.

3b699f357fbd.src: Her crimes were against Man. She killed and broke, leaving lifeless bodies piled in her wake, and snuffing lives with horrific indifference.
3b699f357fbd.dst: 她的罪行是對著人。她殺戮、她摧折，身後留下堆疊的屍體，以令人髮指的冷漠掐熄一條又一條性命。
3b699f357fbd.flat: Her crimes were against Man. She killed and broke, leaving lifeless bodies piled in her wake, and snuffing lives with horrific indifference.

67a02efec0e7.src: A true tactician knows to throw even himself on the pyre, if it is for the greater good.
67a02efec0e7.dst: 真正的戰術家知道，只要是為了大局，連自己也該扔上火堆。
67a02efec0e7.flat: A true tactician knows to throw even himself on the pyre, if it is for the greater good.

b59743d25e38.src: A wand forged from the dust of life itself. It destroys and protects in equal parts.
b59743d25e38.dst: 以生命本身的塵埃鍛成的魔杖。它毀滅與守護的份量恰好相等。
b59743d25e38.flat: A wand forged from the dust of life itself. It destroys and protects in equal parts.

560e1d6bddb8.src: Behind you are the corpses of the weak, of those who deserved to die. Before you are those willing to join them.It's pulling towards something.
560e1d6bddb8.dst: 你身後是弱者的屍體，是那些活該去死的人。你面前，是願意加入他們的人。它正被某種東西牽引著。
560e1d6bddb8.flat: Behind you are the corpses of the weak, of those who deserved to die. Before you are those willing to join them.It's pulling towards something.

c063c4fa2547.dst: 不過是又一次的載歌載舞罷了。

f556855abe4d.src: A great magical cataclysm at {p} brought on by a strange, seemingly disconnected series of events resulted in this wand absorbing nearly uncontrollably high levels of magic.
f556855abe4d.dst: {p} 一場由一連串詭異而看似毫不相干的事件所引發的巨大魔法災變，導致這根魔杖吸收了幾近失控的高濃度魔力。
f556855abe4d.flat: A great magical cataclysm at {p} brought on by a strange, seemingly disconnected series of events resulted in this wand absorbing nearly uncontrollably high levels of magic.
f556855abe4d._raw: A great magical cataclysm at Mage Island brought on by a strange, seemingly disconnected series of events resulted in this wand absorbing nearly uncontrollably high levels of magic.

5949de9ca211.src: Despite the existence of the Nether Portal, few believe that it is possible to open such rifts with sheer force alone. None believe that a tool with enough power to accomplish such a monumental feat could exist. And yet...
5949de9ca211.dst: 儘管下界傳送門確實存在，很少有人相信單憑蠻力就能撕開這樣的裂隙。更沒有人相信，世上會有強大到足以完成這種壯舉的器物。然而……
5949de9ca211.flat: Despite the existence of the Nether Portal, few believe that it is possible to open such rifts with sheer force alone. None believe that a tool with enough power to accomplish such a monumental feat could exist. And yet...

94135ccf586b.src: "The gravestone for the brother of that man, Sayleros? For whatever reason, it didn't have a proper name on it." -Sacre, {p} Priest
94135ccf586b.dst: 「那個叫 Sayleros 的男人，他兄弟的墓碑？不知為何，上面並沒有刻上正式的名字。」—Sacre，{p} 神父
94135ccf586b.flat: "The gravestone for the brother of that man, Sayleros? For whatever reason, it didn't have a proper name on it." -Sacre, {p} Priest
94135ccf586b._raw: "The gravestone for the brother of that man, Sayleros? For whatever reason, it didn't have a proper name on it." -Sacre, Saint's Row Priest

f5e252171c5c.src: Despite appearing as a basic blade when held, strange spiritual magic changes its form into a sharp, ring-like cutting edge when used to attack. Only one person was known to master the weapon's abilities.
f5e252171c5c.dst: 握在手上時它看起來只是一把普通的刃，但用來攻擊時，某種奇異的靈性魔法會把它變成一圈鋒利的環狀刀刃。據知只有一個人真正掌握了這件武器的能耐。
f5e252171c5c.flat: Despite appearing as a basic blade when held, strange spiritual magic changes its form into a sharp, ring-like cutting edge when used to attack. Only one person was known to master the weapon's abilities.

2b1e0bc7d016.src: This blackiron blade was left to sear in the desert for months on end by a fanatical berserker. It burned him alive as he cut down those who opposed him.
2b1e0bc7d016.dst: 這把黑鐵之刃被一名狂熱的狂戰士留在沙漠裡連續曝曬了好幾個月。當他斬殺擋在面前的人時，它把他活活燒死了。
2b1e0bc7d016.flat: This blackiron blade was left to sear in the desert for months on end by a fanatical berserker. It burned him alive as he cut down those who opposed him.

5d9ebe16b9dc.src: War does not bring destruction. With war comes chaos, and with chaos comes destruction.
5d9ebe16b9dc.dst: 戰爭本身不帶來毀滅。戰爭帶來的是混亂，而混亂帶來毀滅。
5d9ebe16b9dc.flat: War does not bring destruction. With war comes chaos, and with chaos comes destruction.

eb9ab3a9b24f.src: Empty threats, thrilling bluffs, false promises: a little bravado goes a long way. Wielded properly, diction can be just as fatal as a knife to the heart, and it's much cleaner besides.
eb9ab3a9b24f.dst: 空洞的威脅、驚險的虛張聲勢、虛假的承諾：一點點膽識就能走得很遠。用得好的話，言詞可以跟一刀刺進心臟一樣致命，而且乾淨得多。
eb9ab3a9b24f.flat: Empty threats, thrilling bluffs, false promises: a little bravado goes a long way. Wielded properly, diction can be just as fatal as a knife to the heart, and it's much cleaner besides.

91b93267a739.src: The carving on this antiquated spear writes: Locedtuh Hahod
91b93267a739.dst: 這桿古舊長矛上的雕紋寫著：Locedtuh Hahod
91b93267a739.flat: The carving on this antiquated spear writes: Locedtuh Hahod

a153e663ae82.src: "My husband's such a scaredy-cat. What good is tomb raiding if you're not in the tomb?"  -Dr. Junes, {p} Archaeologist
a153e663ae82.dst: 「我老公真是個膽小鬼。人都不進墓裡，還盜什麼墓？」—Dr. Junes，{p} 考古學家
a153e663ae82.flat: "My husband's such a scaredy-cat. What good is tomb raiding if you're not in the tomb?"  -Dr. Junes, {p} Archaeologist
a153e663ae82._raw: "My husband's such a scaredy-cat. What good is tomb raiding if you're not in the tomb?"  -Dr. Junes, Almuj Archaeologist

940d61e90ed2.src: The powerful psychic energies surrounding this bow are rumored to increase accuracy, though this has not been refuted by any reliable source.
940d61e90ed2.dst: 據傳環繞這把弓的強大靈能能提升準度，不過這一點也不曾被任何可靠來源推翻過。
940d61e90ed2.flat: The powerful psychic energies surrounding this bow are rumored to increase accuracy, though this has not been refuted by any reliable source.

9ee9aa28aeba.src: The wear on this humble war pick's blade has only made it more effective in combat, allowing its users to make unexpected parries of opponents' attacks by hooking and hitting through the weapon.
9ee9aa28aeba.dst: 這把樸實戰鎬的刃上磨損，反而讓它在戰鬥中更加好用；使用者可以靠勾住並穿透武器，對敵人的攻擊做出出其不意的格擋。
9ee9aa28aeba.flat: The wear on this humble war pick's blade has only made it more effective in combat, allowing its users to make unexpected parries of opponents' attacks by hooking and hitting through the weapon.

0527c6124585.src: The swirl of liquid muck drags you further, further down, into the grasping clutches of the gluttonous hands of the sludge. The earth must be fed; preferably, by something less powerful than you.
0527c6124585.dst: 那團旋轉的液態爛泥把你拖得更深、更深，拖進那些貪婪泥漿伸手抓取的掌握之中。大地必須被餵養；而且最好，是被比你弱的東西。
0527c6124585.flat: The swirl of liquid muck drags you further, further down, into the grasping clutches of the gluttonous hands of the sludge. The earth must be fed; preferably, by something less powerful than you.

16480510c673.src: "It never rains here, but we hear the thunder echoing in the distance."  -Lanu, {p} Archaeomancer
16480510c673.dst: 「這裡從來不下雨，我們卻聽得見遠方雷聲的回音。」—Lanu，{p} 考古術士
16480510c673.flat: "It never rains here, but we hear the thunder echoing in the distance."  -Lanu, {p} Archaeomancer
16480510c673._raw: "It never rains here, but we hear the thunder echoing in the distance."  -Lanu, Almuj Archaeomancer

abf282ce7990.src: Perhaps one is weak. To be ignored. Perhaps two are not much better. But what of five? Ten? Twenty?...
abf282ce7990.dst: 也許一個很弱。不值一提。也許兩個也好不到哪去。那五個呢？十個？二十個？……
abf282ce7990.flat: Perhaps one is weak. To be ignored. Perhaps two are not much better. But what of five? Ten? Twenty?...

509b9f26b2cd.src: Despite the light weight of the weapon, the spearhead has been made from incredibly dense cosmic stone. A strong enough impact can directly destroy matter. Due to this danger, it is sought after to be destroyed.
509b9f26b2cd.dst: 儘管這件武器份量極輕，矛尖卻是用密度高得離譜的宇宙之石打造的。足夠強的一次撞擊便能直接抹除物質。正因如此危險，人們一直想方設法要毀掉它。
509b9f26b2cd.flat: Despite the light weight of the weapon, the spearhead has been made from incredibly dense cosmic stone. A strong enough impact can directly destroy matter. Due to this danger, it is sought after to be destroyed.

bd5dcd20a7e6.src: An attempt to contain dark within light, to strike back at brutality with compassion.  Reality protested. Bring together two forces, and all you have is discord.
bd5dcd20a7e6.dst: 一次把黑暗容納進光明、以慈悲反擊殘暴的嘗試。現實提出了抗議。把兩股力量湊在一起，你得到的只有失和。
bd5dcd20a7e6.flat: An attempt to contain dark within light, to strike back at brutality with compassion.  Reality protested. Bring together two forces, and all you have is discord.

9921b9aa46ee.src: From nothing to everything, forever past to forever more, the vastness of eternity is obscured by the sameness of tomorrow.
9921b9aa46ee.dst: 從無到有，從無盡的過去到無盡的以後；永恆的浩瀚，被明天的千篇一律給遮蔽了。
9921b9aa46ee.flat: From nothing to everything, forever past to forever more, the vastness of eternity is obscured by the sameness of tomorrow.

c89e32dd2469.src: As the void approaches nearer and nearer, the barrier between realms thins almost to a point... And yet, no matter how far you fall or how fast you fly, it will always lie just out of reach. Such is the indeterminate nature of the void, and its power that you harness.
c89e32dd2469.dst: 虛空愈逼愈近，界域之間的屏障薄得幾乎只剩一點……然而無論你墜落多深、飛得多快，它永遠就停在觸不到的地方。虛空的本質即是如此難以捉摸——你所駕馭的那股力量，也是。
c89e32dd2469.flat: As the void approaches nearer and nearer, the barrier between realms thins almost to a point... And yet, no matter how far you fall or how fast you fly, it will always lie just out of reach. Such is the indeterminate nature of the void, and its power that you harness.

c413ea77acb6.src: "Catch a fresh-raised corrupted, it's like catching a soldier without his morning coffee. Stumbly and unfocused." -Enzan, Retired {p} Soldier
c413ea77acb6.dst: 「抓一隻剛爬起來的腐化物，就像抓一個早上還沒喝咖啡的士兵。踉踉蹌蹌、眼神渙散。」——Enzan，{p} 退役士兵
c413ea77acb6.flat: "Catch a fresh-raised corrupted, it's like catching a soldier without his morning coffee. Stumbly and unfocused." -Enzan, Retired {p} Soldier
c413ea77acb6._raw: "Catch a fresh-raised corrupted, it's like catching a soldier without his morning coffee. Stumbly and unfocused." -Enzan, Retired Ragni Soldier

04d369c29919.src: This heavy crossbow forces a strange compulsion in its users when wielded. They will often refuse to even shoot unless entirely certain of a hit.
04d369c29919.dst: 這把沉重的十字弓在使用時會讓持有者生出一種奇怪的強迫。除非完全確定會命中，否則他們往往連射都不肯射。
04d369c29919.flat: This heavy crossbow forces a strange compulsion in its users when wielded. They will often refuse to even shoot unless entirely certain of a hit.

d10688577616.src: The ember manifests kindness. The blaze manifests cruelty. Both share an origin within the sun's flame. But what separates warmth from ruin is not the fire, but the hand that calls upon it. Mercy and wrath are merely reflections cast by the same unblinking star.
d10688577616.dst: 餘燼展現的是仁慈。烈焰展現的是殘酷。兩者的源頭同在太陽的火焰之中。而區分溫暖與毀滅的並不是火本身，是那隻召喚它的手。慈悲與怒火，不過是同一顆從不眨眼的星所投下的兩道倒影。
d10688577616.flat: The ember manifests kindness. The blaze manifests cruelty. Both share an origin within the sun's flame. But what separates warmth from ruin is not the fire, but the hand that calls upon it. Mercy and wrath are merely reflections cast by the same unblinking star.

9ffddbcec58a.src: There is no need to swing this weapon. Your skin crackles as the mere presence of the blade rends the earth beneath it, to falling skies and gaping chasms. Once the dust settles and the air stills, the sword is the only telltale remnant of the catastrophe.
9ffddbcec58a.dst: 這件武器根本不需要揮。光是刃身的存在就讓你的皮膚劈啪作響，讓它底下的大地崩裂，天空墜落、深淵張開。等塵埃落定、空氣靜止，這把劍就是那場浩劫唯一的見證。
9ffddbcec58a.flat: There is no need to swing this weapon. Your skin crackles as the mere presence of the blade rends the earth beneath it, to falling skies and gaping chasms. Once the dust settles and the air stills, the sword is the only telltale remnant of the catastrophe.

d6deeb5ca67d.src: One of the first dwarven theories of the increasing quakes in east Gavel was that the freezing of a Dogun town in the Heights also froze a massive underground spring, disrupting the earth and chain-reacting across the province.
d6deeb5ca67d.dst: 對於 Gavel 東部日益頻繁的地震，矮人最早的假說之一是：Heights 的一座 Dogun 城鎮被凍結時，也一併凍住了一處龐大的地下泉，擾動了地層，於是連鎖反應傳遍整個行省。
d6deeb5ca67d.flat: One of the first dwarven theories of the increasing quakes in east Gavel was that the freezing of a Dogun town in the Heights also froze a massive underground spring, disrupting the earth and chain-reacting across the province.

b57797377045.src: "I got a name, known far and wide! Run along, you bandit scum, before you have to learn it the hard way!" -Sayleros' Brother, killed by bandits
b57797377045.dst: 「我可是有名號的，遠近皆知！滾遠一點，你們這些強盜渣滓，免得非要用難堪的方式學會它！」—Sayleros 的兄弟，死於強盜之手
b57797377045.flat: "I got a name, known far and wide! Run along, you bandit scum, before you have to learn it the hard way!" -Sayleros' Brother, killed by bandits

50de78aa2453.src: Carelessly aloft, between the heavens and the abyss...
50de78aa2453.dst: 漫不經心地漂浮著，在天堂與深淵之間……
50de78aa2453.flat: Carelessly aloft, between the heavens and the abyss...

29f9b44ba84f.src: The weapon of the fearsome lone bandit, {p} Luke, it is unique in that it is designed to fire small metal rounds instead of more traditional projectiles.
29f9b44ba84f.dst: 這是那名令人聞風喪膽的獨行盜匪 {p} Luke 的武器。它的特別之處在於，它設計來發射的是小顆的金屬彈丸，而不是比較傳統的箭矢。
29f9b44ba84f.flat: The weapon of the fearsome lone bandit, {p} Luke, it is unique in that it is designed to fire small metal rounds instead of more traditional projectiles.
29f9b44ba84f._raw: The weapon of the fearsome lone bandit, Rymek Luke, it is unique in that it is designed to fire small metal rounds instead of more traditional projectiles.

b4e2bafe49db.src: "We'll ensure that under our watch, all your families will be reunited!" -Haros, of the Banished Legion
b4e2bafe49db.dst: 「我們保證，在我們的看顧之下，你們的家人都會團聚！」—Haros，放逐軍團成員
b4e2bafe49db.flat: "We'll ensure that under our watch, all your families will be reunited!" -Haros, of the Banished Legion

f53531c3b4a0.src: Decay spreads unseen, but you know it spreads, and that is enough.
f53531c3b4a0.dst: 衰朽在看不見的地方蔓延，但你知道它在蔓延，這樣就夠了。
f53531c3b4a0.flat: Decay spreads unseen, but you know it spreads, and that is enough.

f0ce58f0d492.src: "The first time I saw one of those zombies I nearly had a heart attack! The blighters are terrifying." -Rynend, {p} Citizen
f0ce58f0d492.dst: 「我第一次看到那種殭屍的時候差點心臟病發！那些鬼東西真的很可怕。」—Rynend，{p} 居民
f0ce58f0d492.flat: "The first time I saw one of those zombies I nearly had a heart attack! The blighters are terrifying." -Rynend, {p} Citizen
f0ce58f0d492._raw: "The first time I saw one of those zombies I nearly had a heart attack! The blighters are terrifying." -Rynend, Maltic Citizen

c93b591e0d94.src: This artefact begins deteriorating your flesh from the moment it touches your skin, but its destructive force can be channeled to rot the bodies of any who come near.
c93b591e0d94.dst: 這件遺物從碰到你皮膚的那一刻起就開始讓你的血肉腐壞；但它的破壞之力可以被引導出去，腐蝕任何靠近的人的軀體。
c93b591e0d94.flat: This artefact begins deteriorating your flesh from the moment it touches your skin, but its destructive force can be channeled to rot the bodies of any who come near.

ed4b6f0a5b8b.src: A dusty old tome, containing all the powers of the abyss. From its pages spring forth the blackest of secrets and the darkest of truths. Do not let yourself slip into its grasp, for it will consume you too.
ed4b6f0a5b8b.dst: 一本佈滿灰塵的老書，收著深淵的全部力量。從它的書頁裡湧出最黑的祕密與最暗的真相。別讓自己落進它的掌握，因為它連你也會一併吞掉。
ed4b6f0a5b8b.flat: A dusty old tome, containing all the powers of the abyss. From its pages spring forth the blackest of secrets and the darkest of truths. Do not let yourself slip into its grasp, for it will consume you too.

aab7672d55c2.src: One of {p}' buildings was struck by lightning {~} years ago and burnt to the ground, apart from one wooden beam that began to glow. It was fashioned into an exclusive wand for resident mages.
aab7672d55c2.dst: {~} 年前，{p} 的一棟建築遭雷擊而燒成灰燼，只有一根木梁倖存下來，並開始發光。它被削製成一根專供當地法師使用的魔杖。
aab7672d55c2.flat: One of {p}' buildings was struck by lightning {~} years ago and burnt to the ground, apart from one wooden beam that began to glow. It was fashioned into an exclusive wand for resident mages.
aab7672d55c2._raw: One of Detlas' buildings was struck by lightning 60 years ago and burnt to the ground, apart from one wooden beam that began to glow. It was fashioned into an exclusive wand for resident mages.

d77087920b74.src: One of the most unstable wands known to man. Using the bark of the Flerisi trunk, it reaps fiery destruction upon its enemies.
d77087920b74.dst: 人類已知最不穩定的魔杖之一。它以 Flerisi 樹幹的樹皮製成，為敵人帶來烈火般的毀滅。
d77087920b74.flat: One of the most unstable wands known to man. Using the bark of the Flerisi trunk, it reaps fiery destruction upon its enemies.

42205f9bde79.src: Often, the leader of brute gangs would use this dagger to threaten his followers into making sure they did not fail him.
42205f9bde79.dst: 惡棍幫派的頭目常拿這把匕首威脅手下，確保他們不敢讓他失望。
42205f9bde79.flat: Often, the leader of brute gangs would use this dagger to threaten his followers into making sure they did not fail him.

ce061b261fa0.src: Strangers held together by shared past, entwined in a fray, never to unite again.
ce061b261fa0.dst: 被共同的過去繫在一起的陌生人，在一場混戰中交纏，從此再也不會重聚。
ce061b261fa0.flat: Strangers held together by shared past, entwined in a fray, never to unite again.

26fbd9ee3941.src: Unruly magics of void and darkness are tamed within this bow's string. While those energies are never to be released, arrows fired from it fire at such blinding speeds so as to phase out of existence when they hit their target.
26fbd9ee3941.dst: 狂暴的虛空與黑暗魔法被馴伏在這把弓的弦上。那些能量永遠不會被釋放，但由它射出的箭快得令人目盲，在命中目標的瞬間便自存在之中消失。
26fbd9ee3941.flat: Unruly magics of void and darkness are tamed within this bow's string. While those energies are never to be released, arrows fired from it fire at such blinding speeds so as to phase out of existence when they hit their target.

180e9b8037d9.src: The world is only as small as your heart makes it out to be.
180e9b8037d9.dst: 這個世界有多小，取決於你的心把它想得多小。
180e9b8037d9.flat: The world is only as small as your heart makes it out to be.

f13fbe7531a8.src: Infiltrating a mind is tricky business; warping its thoughts, taking its wishes. It requires precision, skill, and more than a fair bit of luck.
f13fbe7531a8.dst: 侵入一顆心智是件棘手的活兒；扭曲它的念頭、奪走它的願望。那需要精準、技巧，還有相當可觀的運氣。
f13fbe7531a8.flat: Infiltrating a mind is tricky business; warping its thoughts, taking its wishes. It requires precision, skill, and more than a fair bit of luck.

961c0f2a0c24.src: "You don't really advance much when it comes to ovens. For clay, glass, ceramics...it was perfected a long time ago." -Treous, {p} Glassblower
961c0f2a0c24.dst: 「窯這種東西其實沒什麼好進步的。做陶、做玻璃、做瓷器……很久以前就已經做到完美了。」—Treous，{p} 玻璃匠
961c0f2a0c24.flat: "You don't really advance much when it comes to ovens. For clay, glass, ceramics...it was perfected a long time ago." -Treous, {p} Glassblower
961c0f2a0c24._raw: "You don't really advance much when it comes to ovens. For clay, glass, ceramics...it was perfected a long time ago." -Treous, Almuj Glassblower

403ed9cb1787.src: They say the first sip of the ocean's wrath fizzes like champagne. The second burns with a sharp saltiness. By the third, the bubbles rise from your own drowning lungs as the sea claims its aperitif.
403ed9cb1787.dst: 他們說，海洋之怒的第一口會像香檳一樣冒泡。第二口會帶著刺人的鹹澀灼燒。到了第三口，那些氣泡是從你自己溺水的肺裡冒上來的——而大海，正取走屬於它的那杯開胃酒。
403ed9cb1787.flat: They say the first sip of the ocean's wrath fizzes like champagne. The second burns with a sharp saltiness. By the third, the bubbles rise from your own drowning lungs as the sea claims its aperitif.

093981a39ae2.src: Sever every last impurity of the self, and bring to fruition a brilliant culmination of 'you'.
093981a39ae2.dst: 斬去自我最後一絲雜質，讓那個「你」得以璀璨地成形。
093981a39ae2.flat: Sever every last impurity of the self, and bring to fruition a brilliant culmination of 'you'.

8ceff279efca.src: The world is a well of wonder. To open your eyes each day is the greatest gift that can be given. The strength of a thousand lives flows through your veins, and the world embraces you with a reckless, terrible, beautiful, incredible power.
8ceff279efca.dst: 這個世界是一口驚奇之井。每天能睜開眼睛，就是所能得到的最大禮物。千條生命的力量流過你的血管，而這個世界以一股魯莽的、可怖的、美麗的、驚人的力量擁抱著你。
8ceff279efca.flat: The world is a well of wonder. To open your eyes each day is the greatest gift that can be given. The strength of a thousand lives flows through your veins, and the world embraces you with a reckless, terrible, beautiful, incredible power.

7ec54e685537.src: I can't see this through to the end. I have to put my trust in you to finish it.
7ec54e685537.dst: 這件事我沒辦法看到最後了。我只能把它交給你去完成。
7ec54e685537.flat: I can't see this through to the end. I have to put my trust in you to finish it.

12ad587266da.src: This golden staff was recovered from deep within the tombs of {p}. Nothing else was found in the room except the words 'Beware the user with unlimited imagination.'
12ad587266da.dst: 這根金色長杖是從 {p} 陵墓深處取出的。那間墓室裡除了一句話之外什麼也沒有：「當心那個想像力無邊無際的持有者。」
12ad587266da.flat: This golden staff was recovered from deep within the tombs of {p}. Nothing else was found in the room except the words 'Beware the user with unlimited imagination.'
12ad587266da._raw: This golden staff was recovered from deep within the tombs of Almuj. Nothing else was found in the room except the words 'Beware the user with unlimited imagination.'

a23b170b00e4.src: This ornate bow holds a sinister beauty. Each rediscovery marks impending disaster, against any force that attempts to overcome it. Such is the inevitability of fate: irreverent to the will of masses, an epoch starts anew.
a23b170b00e4.dst: 這把華麗的弓有著陰森的美。它每一次重見天日，都預示著一場迫在眉睫的災難，降臨在任何試圖與之抗衡的力量之上。命運的必然莫過於此：它不理會眾人的意志，一個新的紀元就此重新開始。
a23b170b00e4.flat: This ornate bow holds a sinister beauty. Each rediscovery marks impending disaster, against any force that attempts to overcome it. Such is the inevitability of fate: irreverent to the will of masses, an epoch starts anew.

ef85391aa39f.src: No one expected the WynnExcavation volcanic site to produce any valuable materials, but this heavy, obsidian-blend bow silenced the critics.
ef85391aa39f.dst: 沒有人指望 WynnExcavation 的火山工地能挖出什麼值錢的材料，但這把沉重的黑曜混合弓讓所有質疑閉上了嘴。
ef85391aa39f.flat: No one expected the WynnExcavation volcanic site to produce any valuable materials, but this heavy, obsidian-blend bow silenced the critics.

ea1eafd99d31.src: The end comes in threes: first a deep and neverending shadow, suffocating all within its grasp. Then, a piercing blinding radiance, overtaking all within its sight. Finally, the in-between: chaos, bloodshed, war, a conflict which will sweep the land. Each end inevitable; but none a guarantee.
ea1eafd99d31.dst: 終局分三次到來：先是一道深不見底、永不止息的陰影，扼住它所籠罩的一切；接著是一道刺目的強光，吞沒它所照見的一切；最後是夾在兩者之間的那一段——混亂、殺戮、戰爭，一場將席捲大地的衝突。每一次終局都無可避免，卻沒有一次是必然。
ea1eafd99d31.flat: The end comes in threes: first a deep and neverending shadow, suffocating all within its grasp. Then, a piercing blinding radiance, overtaking all within its sight. Finally, the in-between: chaos, bloodshed, war, a conflict which will sweep the land. Each end inevitable; but none a guarantee.

d73e6f74bfe7.src: Supposedly based off of the wand of master mage Ethe, this wand is plated with magic-focusing jewels and heavy gold, yet somehow remains entirely weightless.
d73e6f74bfe7.dst: 據說是以大法師 Ethe 的魔杖為藍本，這根魔杖鑲滿了聚魔寶石與厚重的黃金，卻不知怎麼地依然毫無重量。
d73e6f74bfe7.flat: Supposedly based off of the wand of master mage Ethe, this wand is plated with magic-focusing jewels and heavy gold, yet somehow remains entirely weightless.

11dae366969f.src: When really does the point of no return come? Is it a gentle tug, whispers ushering you calmly to the other side? Is it a stark line, the point between light and dark, life and death? Perhaps you'll find out. Perhaps you already know.
11dae366969f.dst: 不可回頭的那個點究竟何時到來？是一次輕柔的拉扯，低語安撫著把你送往另一側？還是一道分明的界線，光與暗、生與死之間的那一點？也許你會弄清楚。也許你早就知道了。
11dae366969f.flat: When really does the point of no return come? Is it a gentle tug, whispers ushering you calmly to the other side? Is it a stark line, the point between light and dark, life and death? Perhaps you'll find out. Perhaps you already know.

e7456851b3cc.src: Linked by blood, common cause, or pure fate, the clan is an immutable unit. Hundreds of hearts, beating as one, a collective pulse with the power to shake the world to its core.
e7456851b3cc.dst: 無論是靠血緣、共同的目標，或純粹的命運繫在一起，這個氏族都是一個不可分割的整體。數百顆心臟，同一個節拍跳動，那股集體的脈動足以撼動世界的核心。
e7456851b3cc.flat: Linked by blood, common cause, or pure fate, the clan is an immutable unit. Hundreds of hearts, beating as one, a collective pulse with the power to shake the world to its core.

0588e99006f6.src: "Not every spider is venomous, but do you really want to get bitten by them all to figure out which are?" -Alvin, Nivla Forest Resident
0588e99006f6.dst: 「不是每隻蜘蛛都有毒，但你真的想被牠們一隻隻咬過來，好搞清楚哪幾隻有毒嗎？」—Alvin，Nivla 森林居民
0588e99006f6.flat: "Not every spider is venomous, but do you really want to get bitten by them all to figure out which are?" -Alvin, Nivla Forest Resident

14c627b7a8be.src: The confusion of sentience creates unknown and marvelous threads and soundscapes. Joy, grief, hate, love, shock, calm, they reflect back into the pattern and song of the universe. The glow of the Weave, and this brilliant, breathtaking, pale imitation of it, too, resounds in the chorus of existence-one extra layer.
14c627b7a8be.dst: 有靈之物的困惑會織出未知而奇異的絲線與聲景。喜悅、悲慟、憎恨、愛戀、驚駭、平靜，全都映回宇宙的紋理與歌聲之中。「織」的光輝，以及這件燦爛、懾人、卻終究蒼白的仿製品，同樣在存在的合唱裡迴響——多添了一層。
14c627b7a8be.flat: The confusion of sentience creates unknown and marvelous threads and soundscapes. Joy, grief, hate, love, shock, calm, they reflect back into the pattern and song of the universe. The glow of the Weave, and this brilliant, breathtaking, pale imitation of it, too, resounds in the chorus of existence-one extra layer.

582c2f4e2c4a.src: A mage by the name of Lero claims to have harnessed the sheer power of lightning using a magical staff, however, the weapon is very unreliable in a pinch.
582c2f4e2c4a.dst: 一位名叫 Lero 的法師聲稱，他用一根魔法長杖馴服了純粹的雷霆之力；然而這件武器在緊要關頭極不可靠。
582c2f4e2c4a.flat: A mage by the name of Lero claims to have harnessed the sheer power of lightning using a magical staff, however, the weapon is very unreliable in a pinch.

a720fcb7b251.src: A brilliant waltz on the razor's edge. Dance, dance through the fields of broken bodies and the vacant cities of empty people. Become the inevitable; the hands of time announce your interminable arrival. Raise your symphony to a crescendo, now: you are the dealer, and fate is the deck. The whole world will know your song.
a720fcb7b251.dst: 一支在刀鋒上起舞的絢爛華爾滋。跳吧，跳過堆滿殘軀的原野，跳過空無一人的死城。成為那必然；時間之針正宣告著你無可阻擋的到來。此刻，將你的交響推向最高潮吧：你是發牌的人，而命運是那副牌。整個世界都將聽見你的歌。
a720fcb7b251.flat: A brilliant waltz on the razor's edge. Dance, dance through the fields of broken bodies and the vacant cities of empty people. Become the inevitable; the hands of time announce your interminable arrival. Raise your symphony to a crescendo, now: you are the dealer, and fate is the deck. The whole world will know your song.

bac9782cf324.src: Once a contract is formed, and before its details are discussed, a seal is placed on the human's body.
bac9782cf324.dst: 契約一旦成立，在細節被談妥之前，一道封印就會落在那個人類的身上。
bac9782cf324.flat: Once a contract is formed, and before its details are discussed, a seal is placed on the human's body.

926552ac938a.src: Every time this spear hits an enemy, a sharp electrical jolt hits the users hands that forces powerful lightning to release.
926552ac938a.dst: 這桿矛每次擊中敵人，都會有一道尖銳的電流竄回使用者的雙手，迫使強大的閃電釋放出去。
926552ac938a.flat: Every time this spear hits an enemy, a sharp electrical jolt hits the users hands that forces powerful lightning to release.

30d5661f97a5.src: Only the most honourable warriors of Gavel's army are presented the fearsome, fiery spear forged from the rarest metals of the {p}.
30d5661f97a5.dst: 只有 Gavel 軍中最榮譽的戰士，才會獲頒這柄以 {p} 最稀有的金屬鍛成、令人生畏的烈焰長槍。
30d5661f97a5.flat: Only the most honourable warriors of Gavel's army are presented the fearsome, fiery spear forged from the rarest metals of the {p}.
30d5661f97a5._raw: Only the most honourable warriors of Gavel's army are presented the fearsome, fiery spear forged from the rarest metals of the Molten Heights.

f1b3e6a17e43.src: Gunpowder is your favourite scent. It signals peace: the enemies have been blown to high hell. And who doesn't love peace?
f1b3e6a17e43.dst: 火藥是你最喜歡的味道。它代表和平：敵人已經被炸上天了。而誰不愛和平呢？
f1b3e6a17e43.flat: Gunpowder is your favourite scent. It signals peace: the enemies have been blown to high hell. And who doesn't love peace?

6d88fc5e4713.src: A defiant pang joins the ruckus, a tune to run counter to the pain and the chaos of the rest. The strings of the forest are played just so, and the fall of each leaf echoes in an enchanted rhythm.
6d88fc5e4713.dst: 一記倔強的音撞進了這片喧囂，一段與其餘的痛苦與混亂背道而馳的旋律。森林的琴弦就這樣被撥動，而每一片落葉的墜落都在一種魔法般的節奏裡迴響。
6d88fc5e4713.flat: A defiant pang joins the ruckus, a tune to run counter to the pain and the chaos of the rest. The strings of the forest are played just so, and the fall of each leaf echoes in an enchanted rhythm.

d7625ac54632.src: Dwarven folklore tells of this mighty maul, used by gods to break mountains, shape continents, and crack the earth to form caverns.
d7625ac54632.dst: 矮人的民間傳說提到過這柄巨槌：諸神曾用它劈開群山、塑造大陸，並在大地上砸出裂口而成洞窟。
d7625ac54632.flat: Dwarven folklore tells of this mighty maul, used by gods to break mountains, shape continents, and crack the earth to form caverns.

203829d8682a.src: An attempt to penetrate the depths of the abyss; a sacrifice made to a futile end. No avail. Bloodshed paved the way for bloodshed, and evil still operates while blind.
203829d8682a.dst: 一次穿透深淵的嘗試；一場獻給徒勞終局的犧牲。毫無用處。流血只鋪出了更多的流血，而邪惡依然閉著眼睛運作著。
203829d8682a.flat: An attempt to penetrate the depths of the abyss; a sacrifice made to a futile end. No avail. Bloodshed paved the way for bloodshed, and evil still operates while blind.

efcbce5c5f5c.src: Found abandoned in the ruins of the Doguns, these odd weapons are designed to shoot jets of sheer flame instead of hitting enemies traditionally. They are in terrible disrepair, and none know how to fix them.
efcbce5c5f5c.dst: 在 Dogun 的廢墟裡被發現時已遭棄置。這種奇特的武器並非以傳統方式擊打敵人，而是設計來噴出純粹的火柱。它們早已破損不堪，而且沒有人知道該怎麼修。
efcbce5c5f5c.flat: Found abandoned in the ruins of the Doguns, these odd weapons are designed to shoot jets of sheer flame instead of hitting enemies traditionally. They are in terrible disrepair, and none know how to fix them.

a5c46ab29f70.src: A hovercraft scrounged from voidstone. Stained glass dulled to bleak grays. Blueprints and notes in indecipherable tongues. Moments, lost in time-like so  much refuse from the world above.
a5c46ab29f70.dst: 一艘用虛空石拼湊出來的浮空艇。彩繪玻璃褪成了黯淡的灰。難以辨讀的語言寫成的藍圖與筆記。那些失落在時間裡的片刻——一如上面那個世界丟下來的無數殘骸。
a5c46ab29f70.flat: A hovercraft scrounged from voidstone. Stained glass dulled to bleak grays. Blueprints and notes in indecipherable tongues. Moments, lost in time-like so  much refuse from the world above.

8af3c342a876.src: Curious, isn't it, that unending complexity can feel so plain in one's hand, yet pull deeper than eyes can see and minds can fathom?
8af3c342a876.dst: 很奇妙吧？無盡的複雜握在手裡竟能如此平凡，卻又拉得比眼睛看得到、心智想得通的還要更深。
8af3c342a876.flat: Curious, isn't it, that unending complexity can feel so plain in one's hand, yet pull deeper than eyes can see and minds can fathom?

ec05ea849772.src: Freedom of soul, mind, and body are forced upon all those that this bow's arrows impact, and freedom of caring from the atrocities that such a dangerous weapon can inflict is given to all those that hold it.
ec05ea849772.dst: 凡是被這把弓的箭射中的人，都會被強加上靈魂、心智與肉體的自由；而凡是握著它的人，都會得到另一種自由——不必再為這件危險的武器所造成的暴行動一絲心念。
ec05ea849772.flat: Freedom of soul, mind, and body are forced upon all those that this bow's arrows impact, and freedom of caring from the atrocities that such a dangerous weapon can inflict is given to all those that hold it.

2ce436d63e4c.src: It invites you to ride on the warm, soothing gusts it summons. It calls for you to admire the fires it leaves behind, burning the land to a char in its wake. It offers a lifetime of protection, while weaving a tapestry of flames across the world.
2ce436d63e4c.dst: 它邀請你乘上它召喚出的那陣溫暖而舒緩的風。它呼喚你去欣賞它留在身後的火——那些把土地燒成焦炭的火。它提供你一生的守護，同時在世界各處織出一張火焰的織錦。
2ce436d63e4c.flat: It invites you to ride on the warm, soothing gusts it summons. It calls for you to admire the fires it leaves behind, burning the land to a char in its wake. It offers a lifetime of protection, while weaving a tapestry of flames across the world.

160f0e0c690c.src: The Dernel tribes revere various nature deities, each in their own unique fashions. One of the most notable was that of a lost tribe, who fashioned this blossoming stave as tribute to their deity of the earth itself.
160f0e0c690c.dst: Dernel 各部族以各自獨特的方式敬奉不同的自然神祇。其中最著名的一支已經失落，他們打造了這根綻放著花朵的長杖，獻給他們的大地之神。
160f0e0c690c.flat: The Dernel tribes revere various nature deities, each in their own unique fashions. One of the most notable was that of a lost tribe, who fashioned this blossoming stave as tribute to their deity of the earth itself.

da5552b7be5a.src: Those who have used this near-weightless bow all seem to tell tales of how they see Gale's spirit fighting alongside them.
da5552b7be5a.dst: 用過這把近乎無重量的弓的人，似乎都會說起同一件事——他們看見 Gale 的靈魂與自己並肩作戰。
da5552b7be5a.flat: Those who have used this near-weightless bow all seem to tell tales of how they see Gale's spirit fighting alongside them.

c7968e21489a.src: Well...it is a very pretty-looking stick, but aside from that it just appears to be a plain old stick.
c7968e21489a.dst: 嗯……這確實是一根很漂亮的棍子，不過除此之外，它看起來就只是一根普通的舊棍子。
c7968e21489a.flat: Well...it is a very pretty-looking stick, but aside from that it just appears to be a plain old stick.

36ffc7693055.src: Used for endurance training on the Icy Islands, this bow forces the wielder's body temperature to drop to near-hypothermic levels.
36ffc7693055.dst: 在冰之群島用於耐力訓練，這把弓會迫使持有者的體溫降到接近失溫的程度。
36ffc7693055.flat: Used for endurance training on the Icy Islands, this bow forces the wielder's body temperature to drop to near-hypothermic levels.

84b8db8ce3ac.src: The blazing sun has been revered by many druidic sects as a god in its own right, and the jewel in this brilliant wand glows with the brightness of their holy star.
84b8db8ce3ac.dst: 許多德魯伊教派都把熾烈的太陽奉為一位獨立的神，而這根燦爛魔杖上的寶石，正閃耀著他們那顆神聖之星的光芒。
84b8db8ce3ac.flat: The blazing sun has been revered by many druidic sects as a god in its own right, and the jewel in this brilliant wand glows with the brightness of their holy star.

b624a556c67a.src: Pitch black and tipped with golden bands, it appears to grow at its wielder's whim. Strange runes are etched into the side, that flash with a heavenly light.
b624a556c67a.dst: 通體漆黑，頂端箍著金環，它似乎會隨持有者的心意生長。側面刻著奇異的符文，會閃出天國般的光。
b624a556c67a.flat: Pitch black and tipped with golden bands, it appears to grow at its wielder's whim. Strange runes are etched into the side, that flash with a heavenly light.

08da8f55f3d2.src: The stalwart Guard Golems stand as the protectors of Wynn's cities. To wield the remains of one so viciously dismembered by the undead... just how deadly are these hordes?It's pulling towards something.
08da8f55f3d2.dst: 堅毅的守衛魔像是 Wynn 各城市的護衛。要握著一具被不死大軍如此殘暴地肢解後留下的殘骸……那些大軍到底有多致命？它正被什麼東西牽引著。
08da8f55f3d2.flat: The stalwart Guard Golems stand as the protectors of Wynn's cities. To wield the remains of one so viciously dismembered by the undead... just how deadly are these hordes?It's pulling towards something.

071d78262d98.src: Little spikes of corruption grow out of the blades on this weapon, serrating it. They seem to grow after drawing blood, guiding your body to dig further into the enemy's viscera even after they've already died.It's pulling towards something.
071d78262d98.dst: 細小的腐化尖刺從這把武器的刃上長出來，把它變成鋸齒狀。它們似乎在見血之後就會生長，引著你的手往敵人的臟腑裡再挖得更深——即使對方早已死透。它正被什麼東西牽引著。
071d78262d98.flat: Little spikes of corruption grow out of the blades on this weapon, serrating it. They seem to grow after drawing blood, guiding your body to dig further into the enemy's viscera even after they've already died.It's pulling towards something.

7de7d9f35604.src: It's a gravity as abstract as it is physical, of phenomena so fascinating one can't help but be pulled in.
7de7d9f35604.dst: 那是一種既抽象又實在的引力，那些現象迷人到讓人身不由己地被拉了進去。
7de7d9f35604.flat: It's a gravity as abstract as it is physical, of phenomena so fascinating one can't help but be pulled in.

ea73cc809cea.src: The very first crossbow in existence was claimed to be utterly indestructible, but it is only true to a fault. The item cannot be broken, but solely because all damage to it is instead reflected onto the user. As its age is uncountably ancient, wielders will find themselves rapidly aging and withering away with even a mere touch.
ea73cc809cea.dst: 世上第一把弩，據說堅不可摧——而這話只在最壞的意義上為真。它確實無法被損毀，唯一的原因是所有加諸其上的傷害都會轉嫁到使用者身上。由於它的年歲古老得無從計算，持有者哪怕只是碰它一下，也會發現自己迅速衰老、枯萎。
ea73cc809cea.flat: The very first crossbow in existence was claimed to be utterly indestructible, but it is only true to a fault. The item cannot be broken, but solely because all damage to it is instead reflected onto the user. As its age is uncountably ancient, wielders will find themselves rapidly aging and withering away with even a mere touch.

7f51615d6f81.src: Found at the site of the {p}, a curse falls upon on all who don this glove; a decay of the body, to fester in their wounds, and a decay of the mind, to muddle all thought. With it, a notion takes hold: to suffer together is to suffer no more.
7f51615d6f81.dst: 這隻手套是在 {p} 的遺址找到的，凡是戴上它的人都會招來詛咒：肉體腐朽，在傷口裡潰爛；心智腐朽，將一切思緒攪成一團。隨之而來的還有一個念頭，牢牢扎進腦裡——一起受苦，就不算受苦了。
7f51615d6f81.flat: Found at the site of the {p}, a curse falls upon on all who don this glove; a decay of the body, to fester in their wounds, and a decay of the mind, to muddle all thought. With it, a notion takes hold: to suffer together is to suffer no more.
7f51615d6f81._raw: Found at the site of the Caritat Mansion, a curse falls upon on all who don this glove; a decay of the body, to fester in their wounds, and a decay of the mind, to muddle all thought. With it, a notion takes hold: to suffer together is to suffer no more.

022b71e39843.src: A vow of protection hangs over this spear, now inhabited by the spirit of a legendary heroine. Even simply a glimpse of the burning blade will instill a feeling of protection and security, and that feeling will hold true if one is brave enough to wield it.
022b71e39843.dst: 一道守護的誓言籠罩著這桿長矛，如今一位傳說中的女英雄之魂就棲居其中。光是瞥見那道燃燒的刃鋒，就足以讓人感到被護持、被安放；而只要有人有膽量握起它，那份感覺就會成真。
022b71e39843.flat: A vow of protection hangs over this spear, now inhabited by the spirit of a legendary heroine. Even simply a glimpse of the burning blade will instill a feeling of protection and security, and that feeling will hold true if one is brave enough to wield it.

b682f66be716.src: Carved from unknown parts of a sea creature unseen, the goliath scales of this effigy of the deep bring forth...a pull. A weight, a pressure. A terrible, crushing depth brought onto the holder, blanketing them like nostalgia. Their owner watches, part of itself acutely aware of its missing pieces.
b682f66be716.dst: 這尊深海的雕像取自某種從未有人見過的海中巨獸，那些不知是何部位的巨鱗帶來的是……一股拉扯。一種重量，一種壓迫。一道可怖的、足以壓碎一切的深度落在持有者身上，像鄉愁一樣把他裹住。它的主人在看著，而它自身的某一部分，清楚地知道自己還缺著什麼。
b682f66be716.flat: Carved from unknown parts of a sea creature unseen, the goliath scales of this effigy of the deep bring forth...a pull. A weight, a pressure. A terrible, crushing depth brought onto the holder, blanketing them like nostalgia. Their owner watches, part of itself acutely aware of its missing pieces.

50d3acdd7762.src: As a flashing star shot through the night sky, a sole observer witnessed its brilliance. It was then, wreathed in prismatic light, he decided. Someday, he would shine as bright as that star, and overtake those beneath him. No matter the cost.
50d3acdd7762.dst: 當一顆流星劃過夜空，只有一名觀者見證了那份燦爛。就在那一刻，沐浴在稜彩之光中的他下定了決心：總有一天，他要像那顆星一樣明亮，並且凌駕於所有在他之下的人。不計代價。
50d3acdd7762.flat: As a flashing star shot through the night sky, a sole observer witnessed its brilliance. It was then, wreathed in prismatic light, he decided. Someday, he would shine as bright as that star, and overtake those beneath him. No matter the cost.

094990bbf0c7.src: The most dangerous enemy is one you cannot see. Hidden amidst a flurry of petals comes an avalanche of blows, in one moment dissolving mountains and forests into a growing amalgam, leaving a wake of vibrant bloom in the next.
094990bbf0c7.dst: 最危險的敵人，是你看不見的那一個。在漫天飛舞的花瓣之後，來的是一場雪崩般的連擊；前一瞬還把山林融成一團不斷增生的混合物，下一瞬便在身後留下一片鮮麗的盛放。
094990bbf0c7.flat: The most dangerous enemy is one you cannot see. Hidden amidst a flurry of petals comes an avalanche of blows, in one moment dissolving mountains and forests into a growing amalgam, leaving a wake of vibrant bloom in the next.

6ce38283c3bb.src: The weathered oar of Haros, the outcast ferryman of Charon's Forsaken Legion. Magical implements have been jury-rigged onto the silver pole, glowing dull out of his bony grasp.
6ce38283c3bb.dst: Haros 那支飽經風霜的槳——他是 Charon 遺棄軍團裡被逐出的擺渡人。銀色的桿身上被草率地加裝了魔法器具，在他嶙峋的手中透出黯淡的光。
6ce38283c3bb.flat: The weathered oar of Haros, the outcast ferryman of Charon's Forsaken Legion. Magical implements have been jury-rigged onto the silver pole, glowing dull out of his bony grasp.

4a7ee4773ecd.src: Corkian technology was not the first to create an item that is capable  of recording noise. Artifacts from {p} were found to record ambient  sounds and distort them into ear-splitting sonic bursts.
4a7ee4773ecd.dst: Corkus 的科技並不是最早造出能錄音之物的。{p} 出土的遺物被發現能錄下環境音，再把它們扭曲成足以震裂耳膜的音爆。
4a7ee4773ecd.flat: Corkian technology was not the first to create an item that is capable  of recording noise. Artifacts from {p} were found to record ambient  sounds and distort them into ear-splitting sonic bursts.
4a7ee4773ecd._raw: Corkian technology was not the first to create an item that is capable  of recording noise. Artifacts from Time Valley were found to record ambient  sounds and distort them into ear-splitting sonic bursts.

7ece77d9fd01.src: The runes carved onto the spear shift appearance so quickly as to be illegible, but those who wield it supposedly will learn their meaning.
7ece77d9fd01.dst: 刻在這桿矛上的符文變換得太快，快到無法辨讀；不過據說持有它的人終究會學會它們的意思。
7ece77d9fd01.flat: The runes carved onto the spear shift appearance so quickly as to be illegible, but those who wield it supposedly will learn their meaning.

2e41cc8a751a.src: "Betrayal stings sharper than a scorpion's tail, and festers worse than the poison inside."   -Attributed to Hashr
2e41cc8a751a.dst: 「背叛的刺比蠍尾更尖，潰爛得比裡面的毒更糟。」—相傳為 Hashr 所言
2e41cc8a751a.flat: "Betrayal stings sharper than a scorpion's tail, and festers worse than the poison inside."   -Attributed to Hashr

bb2946255b68.src: Everything slowly loses heat, and will eventually stop moving. Are you prepared?
bb2946255b68.dst: 一切都在緩慢地失去熱量，終將停止運動。你準備好了嗎？
bb2946255b68.flat: Everything slowly loses heat, and will eventually stop moving. Are you prepared?

a48c9e694df3.src: Among the outcasts of {p}, some preach that death is not to be feared. They say while the road to his door is hellish, and his messenger most cruel, the beyond forgives. In this gilded spear, you see not only a weapon, but a key, a ticket. You know what to do. Be the messenger.
a48c9e694df3.dst: 在 {p} 的被逐者之中，有些人宣講死亡並不可懼。他們說，通往祂門前的路雖然如同煉獄、祂的使者雖然無比殘酷，但彼岸會寬恕。在這柄鎏金之矛裡，你看見的不只是武器，還是一把鑰匙、一張門票。你知道該怎麼做。去當那個使者吧。
a48c9e694df3.flat: Among the outcasts of {p}, some preach that death is not to be feared. They say while the road to his door is hellish, and his messenger most cruel, the beyond forgives. In this gilded spear, you see not only a weapon, but a key, a ticket. You know what to do. Be the messenger.
a48c9e694df3._raw: Among the outcasts of Efilim, some preach that death is not to be feared. They say while the road to his door is hellish, and his messenger most cruel, the beyond forgives. In this gilded spear, you see not only a weapon, but a key, a ticket. You know what to do. Be the messenger.

4307fd2f9cd6.src: For the hundreds sacrificed for {p}'s survival, death was not the end. Residual dark magic and corrupted energy manifests in this weapon as faint echoes of sorrow and agony from the slain who were denied peace.It's pulling towards something.
4307fd2f9cd6.dst: 為了 {p} 的存續而被獻祭的那數百人，死亡並不是終點。殘留的黑暗魔法與腐化能量在這把武器裡顯現，成為那些不得安息的亡者留下的、微弱的悲鳴與痛楚回音。它正被什麼東西牽引著。
4307fd2f9cd6.flat: For the hundreds sacrificed for {p}'s survival, death was not the end. Residual dark magic and corrupted energy manifests in this weapon as faint echoes of sorrow and agony from the slain who were denied peace.It's pulling towards something.
4307fd2f9cd6._raw: For the hundreds sacrificed for Troms's survival, death was not the end. Residual dark magic and corrupted energy manifests in this weapon as faint echoes of sorrow and agony from the slain who were denied peace.It's pulling towards something.

8bf36b8ed02e.src: Face the flames with resolution in your eyes. Once you're down in the brimstone, you're not going back.
8bf36b8ed02e.dst: 帶著眼裡的決意直面火焰。一旦下到硫磺裡，你就回不去了。
8bf36b8ed02e.flat: Face the flames with resolution in your eyes. Once you're down in the brimstone, you're not going back.

afe8b5fc414c.src: This profane bow was crafted by a Kander cabal in opposition to the House of Talor's holy relic. Holding it for too long will strain and warp the user's mind.
afe8b5fc414c.dst: 這把褻瀆之弓是由 Kander 密教團所造，用以對抗 Talor 家的聖物。握著它太久，會使持有者的心智緊繃、扭曲。
afe8b5fc414c.flat: This profane bow was crafted by a Kander cabal in opposition to the House of Talor's holy relic. Holding it for too long will strain and warp the user's mind.

3731fc29cf35.src: One of Skien's many deadly weapons. This warhammer, despite the massive weight of the hammerhead, was able to be swung by Skien fast enough to be a blur.
3731fc29cf35.dst: Skien 眾多致命武器之一。這把戰錘的錘頭雖然重得驚人，Skien 卻能揮得快到只剩一道殘影。
3731fc29cf35.flat: One of Skien's many deadly weapons. This warhammer, despite the massive weight of the hammerhead, was able to be swung by Skien fast enough to be a blur.

f26962d005ab.src: Reconstructed from mere wooden scraps of its former self, this extremely heavy crossbow still contains immense power. It was intended for use with a lost suit of armor, of which only one piece remains.
f26962d005ab.dst: 僅憑昔日殘留的木料碎片重建而成，這把極為沉重的十字弓依然蘊含著龐大的力量。它原本要搭配一套已經失傳的盔甲使用，而那套盔甲如今只剩一件。
f26962d005ab.flat: Reconstructed from mere wooden scraps of its former self, this extremely heavy crossbow still contains immense power. It was intended for use with a lost suit of armor, of which only one piece remains.

4c642e443f4f.src: The calm before the storm is a time of preparation, of perseverance until clearer days. But this? This is the last moment of peace they will ever know.
4c642e443f4f.dst: 暴風雨前的寧靜是用來準備的，是為了撐到天色轉晴。但這一次不是。這是他們此生所能知道的最後一刻安寧。
4c642e443f4f.flat: The calm before the storm is a time of preparation, of perseverance until clearer days. But this? This is the last moment of peace they will ever know.

5ac701b6f6b8.src: Enigmatically, this weapon will only show itself to those who believe themselves to be worth nothing, or to be weak. While utilizing this weapon will greatly strengthen one's resolve, it will disappear when it is no longer needed, going to the next wielder.
5ac701b6f6b8.dst: 不可思議的是，這件武器只會現身於那些自認一文不值、或自認軟弱的人面前。使用它會大幅堅定一個人的意志；而當它不再被需要時便會消失，前往下一位持有者身邊。
5ac701b6f6b8.flat: Enigmatically, this weapon will only show itself to those who believe themselves to be worth nothing, or to be weak. While utilizing this weapon will greatly strengthen one's resolve, it will disappear when it is no longer needed, going to the next wielder.

afadfed704f0.src: Watch as they receive your gift of imminent disaster and endless fallout.
afadfed704f0.dst: 看著他們收下你的禮物：迫在眉睫的災難，與沒完沒了的落塵。
afadfed704f0.flat: Watch as they receive your gift of imminent disaster and endless fallout.

1f05dd96105b.src: To quell the most hateful energies, to focus the most erratic wills, to understand the most alien voices, to shake the most uncaring forces, to capture the most ephemeral potential. The final work of many scholars: to command the world in its most pure being.
1f05dd96105b.dst: 平息最充滿恨意的能量，聚焦最反覆無常的意志，理解最陌異的聲音，撼動最無動於衷的力量，捕捉最短暫易逝的可能。這是眾多學者最後的成果：以世界最純粹的樣貌，號令世界。
1f05dd96105b.flat: To quell the most hateful energies, to focus the most erratic wills, to understand the most alien voices, to shake the most uncaring forces, to capture the most ephemeral potential. The final work of many scholars: to command the world in its most pure being.

0d92f1a38e29.src: "I saw that spider queen once. It felt like it was only a matter of time before she found my home, so I moved here." -Babhla, Nivla Bowl Merchant
0d92f1a38e29.dst: 「我見過那隻蜘蛛女王一次。那感覺就像她找上我家只是時間問題，所以我就搬來了這裡。」—Babhla，Nivla 碗具商人
0d92f1a38e29.flat: "I saw that spider queen once. It felt like it was only a matter of time before she found my home, so I moved here." -Babhla, Nivla Bowl Merchant

85a124eec88f.src: The winds are a curious thing. The light breeze is calming, pleasant. The gale buffets and breaks things, as though it were a child's tantrum. Only the storm truly destroys, bearing its gusts against anyone or anything that would stand in its way, leaving behind only ruin and dust.
85a124eec88f.dst: 風是很奇妙的東西。輕風令人平靜、舒服。強風拍打、摧折，像個鬧脾氣的孩子。唯有風暴真正帶來毀滅，把陣風壓向任何膽敢擋路的人或物，身後只留下廢墟與塵土。
85a124eec88f.flat: The winds are a curious thing. The light breeze is calming, pleasant. The gale buffets and breaks things, as though it were a child's tantrum. Only the storm truly destroys, bearing its gusts against anyone or anything that would stand in its way, leaving behind only ruin and dust.

9a9f3ceab4c6.src: A blade crafted from the ocean's elements. It slices through enemies with the grace of the tides.
9a9f3ceab4c6.dst: 以海洋的元素打造的刃。它斬過敵人時帶著潮汐般的優雅。
9a9f3ceab4c6.flat: A blade crafted from the ocean's elements. It slices through enemies with the grace of the tides.

5ad6f63fdcf9.src: Only years of training, of building tolerance, has allowed you resistance to the onslaught; channeling the unstoppability of a torrent unleashed. Your enemy stands no chance.
5ad6f63fdcf9.dst: 唯有多年的訓練、逐步建立起的耐受，才讓你抵擋得住這場猛攻；並得以引導那股洪流被放出時的不可阻擋。你的敵人毫無勝算。
5ad6f63fdcf9.flat: Only years of training, of building tolerance, has allowed you resistance to the onslaught; channeling the unstoppability of a torrent unleashed. Your enemy stands no chance.

cdbd1967b29c.src: "The dead can still hear. I figure a lullaby might help convince them to sleep a bit longer." -Merloni, {p} Priest
cdbd1967b29c.dst: 「死者還是聽得見的。我想搖籃曲或許能說服他們再多睡一會兒。」—Merloni，{p} 神父
cdbd1967b29c.flat: "The dead can still hear. I figure a lullaby might help convince them to sleep a bit longer." -Merloni, {p} Priest
cdbd1967b29c._raw: "The dead can still hear. I figure a lullaby might help convince them to sleep a bit longer." -Merloni, Saint's Row Priest

151d757bac80.flat: An attempt to bring power into the hands of one: wealth weaponized across a province to this end. A hero revolted. Crystals burned and plans were brought to dust.

a3222a3cf9ce.src: Intricate carvings and images, almost like that of a totem pole, cover the shaft of this marvelous trident, dredged up from the {p}. Foreign magics heighten the senses of its user in battle, but also instills a longing for the ocean. Many have succumbed to this urge and drowned themselves.

a3222a3cf9ce.flat: Intricate carvings and images, almost like that of a totem pole, cover the shaft of this marvelous trident, dredged up from the {p}. 53bb07ad52ec.src: This bow, used by the dwarves to land the final blow in the slaughter of Garaheth, is extremely powerful. Special fire resistant gloves must be worn at all times to prevent burns to the user.
53bb07ad52ec.dst: 這把弓是矮人用來對 Garaheth 補上最後一擊的，威力極其驚人。使用時必須全程戴著特製的抗火手套，否則會被灼傷。
53bb07ad52ec.flat: This bow, used by the dwarves to land the final blow in the slaughter of Garaheth, is extremely powerful. Special fire resistant gloves must be worn at all times to prevent burns to the user.

b834f826f0d3.dst: 以從 Ozoth 身上削下的燃燒鱗片鍛成；那位傳說中的 {p} 黃金忍者，曾用這桿輕盈卻硬過鋼的長柄武器窮追不捨地獵殺獵物。
b834f826f0d3.flat: Forged with flaming scales shorn from Ozoth, the fabled Golden Ninja of the {p} hunted his prey relentlessly using this lightweight, yet harder than steel, polearm.
