c229a7592036.src: The act of self-immolation is never taken lightly, and is always a sacrifice. This idol was carved to honor one such instance, in which a master of flame burned through his life force in a final act of heroism-purging an encroaching army of the undead, saving the people of the jungle from destruction.
c229a7592036.dst: 自焚從來不是輕率的舉動，那永遠是一種獻祭。這尊雕像正是為了紀念其中一次而刻——一位掌火的大師燃盡了自己的生命力，以英雄之姿完成最後一件事：滌淨一支步步進逼的不死大軍，將叢林的人們從毀滅之中救了下來。
c229a7592036.flat: The act of self-immolation is never taken lightly, and is always a sacrifice. This idol was carved to honor one such instance, in which a master of flame burned through his life force in a final act of heroism-purging an encroaching army of the undead, saving the people of the jungle from destruction.

061386496c53.src: Prolonged exposure to the corruption may cause sudden bursts of madness in soldiers. To assure themselves of their sanity, some have even begun to play tricks on their brethren.
061386496c53.dst: 長期暴露在腐化之中，可能讓士兵突然陷入瘋狂。為了確認自己還清醒，有些人甚至開始捉弄同袍。
061386496c53.flat: Prolonged exposure to the corruption may cause sudden bursts of madness in soldiers. To assure themselves of their sanity, some have even begun to play tricks on their brethren.

c11a1677ce3b.src: She wears a dozen masks, each fragile as the surface of a lake. The shards of her discarded personage are sharp enough to kill.
c11a1677ce3b.dst: 她戴著十幾張面具，每一張都薄得像湖面。而她丟棄的那些人格的碎片，銳利得足以殺人。
c11a1677ce3b.flat: She wears a dozen masks, each fragile as the surface of a lake. The shards of her discarded personage are sharp enough to kill.

430e05c7c7e1.src: Trapped within the deep reaches of the void holes for millenia, this ancient relic has been unrecognizably warped by its own nonexistence. Instead of integrating back to reality upon its return, it brings with it the manic dissociation from a world that cannot be understood.
430e05c7c7e1.dst: 在虛空之洞的深處被困了數千年，這件遠古遺物已被自身的「不存在」扭曲得面目全非。回歸之後它並沒有重新融入現實，反而帶回了一種來自無法被理解的世界的狂躁疏離。
430e05c7c7e1.flat: Trapped within the deep reaches of the void holes for millenia, this ancient relic has been unrecognizably warped by its own nonexistence. Instead of integrating back to reality upon its return, it brings with it the manic dissociation from a world that cannot be understood.

4608d506df76.src: Holding this staff, you feel less . . . physical. Less real. The wind blows through you, blows past you, as though this world wasn't meant for you at all.
4608d506df76.dst: 握著這根長杖，你覺得自己沒那麼……實體了。沒那麼真實。風穿過你、掠過你，彷彿這個世界本來就不是為你而設的。
4608d506df76.flat: Holding this staff, you feel less . . . physical. Less real. The wind blows through you, blows past you, as though this world wasn't meant for you at all.

65b91646f7a4.src: A curious prototype from the labs of Sock Brewing, simply looking at this liquored effigy begins to induce vertigo, tipsiness, and then shortly afterward the ever-familiar mania which only drink can inspire.
65b91646f7a4.dst: 一件出自 Sock Brewing 實驗室的奇特原型；光是看著這尊浸過酒的雕像，就開始引發暈眩、微醺，接著很快就是那股只有酒才喚得起的、再熟悉不過的躁狂。
65b91646f7a4.flat: A curious prototype from the labs of Sock Brewing, simply looking at this liquored effigy begins to induce vertigo, tipsiness, and then shortly afterward the ever-familiar mania which only drink can inspire.

fd1ab321e231.src: The Dogun God Garaheth was actually an immense fire demon occupying the bowels of {p}. Although unwise, the Dwarves forged a demonic dagger using his tooth in celebration of his slaughter.
fd1ab321e231.dst: Dogun 人的神 Garaheth，其實是一頭盤據在 {p} 深處的巨大火焰惡魔。儘管此舉並不明智，矮人仍用牠的一顆牙鍛出了這把惡魔匕首，以慶祝屠殺牠的功績。
fd1ab321e231.flat: The Dogun God Garaheth was actually an immense fire demon occupying the bowels of {p}. Although unwise, the Dwarves forged a demonic dagger using his tooth in celebration of his slaughter.
fd1ab321e231._raw: The Dogun God Garaheth was actually an immense fire demon occupying the bowels of Molten Heights. Although unwise, the Dwarves forged a demonic dagger using his tooth in celebration of his slaughter.

603eeefb8341.src: From coals to conflagration, the flames of War flicker forever.It's pulling towards something.
603eeefb8341.dst: 從煤炭到烈焰，戰爭之火永遠不熄。它正被某種東西牽引著。
603eeefb8341.flat: From coals to conflagration, the flames of War flicker forever.It's pulling towards something.

387e9e769a05.src: For when one needs to carve the smallest stone or pick the smallest lock, the subtleties of precision approach impossibility.
387e9e769a05.dst: 當一個人得雕出最小的石頭、撬開最小的鎖時，精準的微妙之處已經逼近不可能。
387e9e769a05.flat: For when one needs to carve the smallest stone or pick the smallest lock, the subtleties of precision approach impossibility.

f29bce4cf1ae.src: If you reach for ammunition from your quiver, as long as you have a single arrow, you will find you never run out.
f29bce4cf1ae.dst: 只要你的箭袋裡還有一支箭，伸手去拿的時候，你就會發現它永遠取之不盡。
f29bce4cf1ae.flat: If you reach for ammunition from your quiver, as long as you have a single arrow, you will find you never run out.

1bf9b39f6c17.src: This knife does not belong in your hands... yet somehow it feels right at home.
1bf9b39f6c17.dst: 這把刀不該在你手上……卻不知怎麼地，握起來如此順手。
1bf9b39f6c17.flat: This knife does not belong in your hands... yet somehow it feels right at home.

e8431f4ffa29.src: Deceptively plain-looking, this bow has been infused with energy from all five known elements. Its string radiates a spectrum of colors.
e8431f4ffa29.dst: 外表看似平凡，這把弓卻灌注了已知五大元素的全部能量。它的弦散發出一整片光譜的色彩。
e8431f4ffa29.flat: Deceptively plain-looking, this bow has been infused with energy from all five known elements. Its string radiates a spectrum of colors.

c73b983ec6e6.dst: 外表看似平凡，這把匕首卻灌注了已知五大元素的全部能量。它揮過之處留下的殘影會以整片光譜的色彩搏動。
c73b983ec6e6.flat: Deceptively plain-looking, this dagger has been infused with energy from all five known elements. It leaves afterimages that pulsate in a spectrum of colors.

c09608ae22a8.src: Deceptively plain-looking, this relik has been infused with energy from all five known elements. The head gleams in a spectrum of colors.
c09608ae22a8.dst: 外表看似平凡，這件法器卻灌注了已知五大元素的全部能量。頂端閃耀著一整片光譜的色彩。

5f8e683cce69.dst: 外表看似平凡，這根魔杖卻灌注了已知五大元素的全部能量。它隱隱發出一整片光譜的色彩。

c0257575c0a5.src: Excessive force is an ideal to strive for. Disproportionate violence is your right to protect.
c0257575c0a5.dst: 過度的武力是值得追求的理想。不成比例的暴力是你護身的權利。
c0257575c0a5.flat: Excessive force is an ideal to strive for. Disproportionate violence is your right to protect.

7ad7ed4fa3a1.src: They have pillaged your faithful houses and razed your sacred fields. Imbued within this lance is an aspect of holy power, and with it you will bring Hell itself up to meet these vile transgressors.
7ad7ed4fa3a1.dst: 他們劫掠了你虔信的殿堂，焚平了你神聖的田地。這桿長槍中灌注著一縷神聖之力，而你將以它把地獄本身提上來迎接這些可鄙的僭越者。
7ad7ed4fa3a1.flat: They have pillaged your faithful houses and razed your sacred fields. Imbued within this lance is an aspect of holy power, and with it you will bring Hell itself up to meet these vile transgressors.

696ef6269ecf.src: It has witnessed the rise and fall of thousands of civilizations. It has observed the birth and death of millions of stars. It has seen universes open and close. It watches... as each second of eternity passes.
696ef6269ecf.dst: 它見證過數千個文明的興起與衰亡。它觀察過數百萬顆恆星的生與死。它看過宇宙開啟又閉合。它就這樣看著……永恆的每一秒流過。
696ef6269ecf.flat: It has witnessed the rise and fall of thousands of civilizations. It has observed the birth and death of millions of stars. It has seen universes open and close. It watches... as each second of eternity passes.

37f228ca28fa.src: These bulky-looking gauntlets are actually extremely lightweight, being created of a magical elf-blessed iron alloy blend.
37f228ca28fa.dst: 這副看似笨重的護手其實極為輕盈，因為它是以一種受過精靈祝福的魔法鐵合金製成的。
37f228ca28fa.flat: These bulky-looking gauntlets are actually extremely lightweight, being created of a magical elf-blessed iron alloy blend.

b65a32e0e031.src: Many said making a bow out of iron would be slow and wasteful, but the weight of the iron arrow can pierce even stone.
b65a32e0e031.dst: 很多人說用鐵做弓既遲鈍又浪費，但鐵箭的重量連石頭都貫得穿。
b65a32e0e031.flat: Many said making a bow out of iron would be slow and wasteful, but the weight of the iron arrow can pierce even stone.

87a93024678c.src: The holy blade of the House of Talor was crafted of pure unicorn horns, and consecrated by a hundred priests. Evil spirits are driven away by its mere presence.
87a93024678c.dst: Talor 家的聖刃以純粹的獨角獸角製成，並由一百位祭司加持過。光是它的存在就能驅走邪靈。
87a93024678c.flat: The holy blade of the House of Talor was crafted of pure unicorn horns, and consecrated by a hundred priests. Evil spirits are driven away by its mere presence.

416c88729739.src: "The vines you'll find among the foliage make for great rope!" -Alekin's Guide to Plant Fiber Cordage
416c88729739.dst: 「你在草叢裡找到的那些藤蔓，拿來當繩子好用得很！」—Alekin 的植物纖維繩索指南
416c88729739.flat: "The vines you'll find among the foliage make for great rope!" -Alekin's Guide to Plant Fiber Cordage

4eb7686453ef.src: You do not recognize this place. A labyrinth of foreign walls closes in on you. Paths you have walked a thousand times now alien. Are these your hands? They are made of unfamiliar flesh.
4eb7686453ef.dst: 你認不出這個地方。一座由陌生牆壁構成的迷宮朝你逼近。那些你走過上千次的路，如今全成了異境。這是你的手嗎？它們是由陌生的血肉構成的。
4eb7686453ef.flat: You do not recognize this place. A labyrinth of foreign walls closes in on you. Paths you have walked a thousand times now alien. Are these your hands? They are made of unfamiliar flesh.

cab2486d5a06.dst: 「被強盜打得睡不著覺？這裡免費教你打架！只要 {~} 綠寶石——保證讓他們搞不清楚自己被什麼打到！」—{p} 自衛課程廣告
cab2486d5a06.flat: "Bandit attacks losing you sleep? Free fighting classes here! Only {~} emeralds- they won't know what hit 'em!" -{p} Self-Defense Class Advertisement
cab2486d5a06._raw: "Bandit attacks losing you sleep? Free fighting classes here! Only 10 emeralds- they won't know what hit 'em!" -Almuj Self-Defense Class Advertisement

0c0caf06ccaf.src: Soldiers and sorcerers, mere men who think themselves judgement. Not so. Judgement is beyond the sword, beyond the staff; justice prefers different weapons. There is nothing, nothing at all, out of its reach.
0c0caf06ccaf.dst: 士兵與術士，不過是自以為是裁決的凡人罷了。並非如此。裁決在劍之外、在杖之外；正義偏好的是別種武器。沒有任何東西，一丁點也沒有，能逃出它的手掌心。
0c0caf06ccaf.flat: Soldiers and sorcerers, mere men who think themselves judgement. Not so. Judgement is beyond the sword, beyond the staff; justice prefers different weapons. There is nothing, nothing at all, out of its reach.

fb2f9d5f2bcd.src: "When payback is the rule of the land, it feels safest to do nothing."  -Ormrod, Self-exiled {p} Resident
fb2f9d5f2bcd.dst: 「當報復成了這片土地的規矩，什麼都不做反而最安全。」—Ormrod，自我流放的 {p} 居民
fb2f9d5f2bcd.flat: "When payback is the rule of the land, it feels safest to do nothing."  -Ormrod, Self-exiled {p} Resident
fb2f9d5f2bcd._raw: "When payback is the rule of the land, it feels safest to do nothing."  -Ormrod, Self-exiled Almuj Resident

cf9ba27225fb.src: This bow, which grants its wielder the gift of increased sight, was forged by a blind blacksmith determined to protect others from his sightless fate.
cf9ba27225fb.dst: 這把弓能賜予持有者更敏銳的視力；它出自一位盲眼鐵匠之手，而他一心要讓別人免於自己這樣看不見的命運。
cf9ba27225fb.flat: This bow, which grants its wielder the gift of increased sight, was forged by a blind blacksmith determined to protect others from his sightless fate.

fa75e9242f57.src: Left. Right. Left. Right. They are desperate for an escape, merely playthings in a maze of your design. Left. Left. Right.  Turn back. When mountains of stone can shift at your command, their world is reduced to a single path. Left. Right. Does it ever end?
fa75e9242f57.dst: 左。右。左。右。他們拼了命想找到出口，卻不過是你設計的迷宮裡的玩物。左。左。右。回頭。當石造的山巒能隨你一句話挪移，他們的世界就只剩下一條路了。左。右。這到底有沒有盡頭？
fa75e9242f57.flat: Left. Right. Left. Right. They are desperate for an escape, merely playthings in a maze of your design. Left. Left. Right.  Turn back. When mountains of stone can shift at your command, their world is reduced to a single path. Left. Right. Does it ever end?

bafb140ef638.src: When the lost city of Sarnfic sunk beneath the depths, nothing but the bubbles of screams and this single wand surfaced. When used, you can still hear the town's lament.
bafb140ef638.dst: 當失落之城 Sarnfic 沉入深淵，浮上水面的只有一串串尖叫化成的氣泡，以及這根魔杖。使用它的時候，你依然能聽見那座城的悲鳴。
bafb140ef638.flat: When the lost city of Sarnfic sunk beneath the depths, nothing but the bubbles of screams and this single wand surfaced. When used, you can still hear the town's lament.

1f675f03d983.src: A rage unseen, yet so beautiful, that when you laid your eyes upon it, you knew it had to be unleashed. No matter the cost.
1f675f03d983.dst: 一股不曾被見過、卻美得驚人的狂怒；當你的目光落在它身上時，你就知道它非被放出來不可。不計代價。
1f675f03d983.flat: A rage unseen, yet so beautiful, that when you laid your eyes upon it, you knew it had to be unleashed. No matter the cost.

32e66e36a2fa.src: Many have tried to duplicate the properties of this spear, but very few have succeeded in enchanting a spearhead with explosive magic that does not cause the spear itself to explode.
32e66e36a2fa.dst: 許多人試圖複製這桿矛的特性，但極少有人能成功地在矛尖上附加爆裂魔法、同時又不讓矛本身跟著炸開。
32e66e36a2fa.flat: Many have tried to duplicate the properties of this spear, but very few have succeeded in enchanting a spearhead with explosive magic that does not cause the spear itself to explode.

「縱使千萬人阻攔，也要向著永恆的 Fruma。」
這段刻文已經風化得極為嚴重。
d21dfa251a96.flat: "Against all heed, to Fruma eternal." The engraving appears extremely weathered.

2703f9677773.src: Skien's trust in others was shattered permanently by the wielder of this dagger, who fell to the corruption and attacked his legion during a great corrupted siege.
2703f9677773.dst: Skien 對他人的信任，被這把匕首的持有者永遠地擊碎了——那人在一場大規模腐化圍城中墮入腐化，反過來攻擊了他的軍團。
2703f9677773.flat: Skien's trust in others was shattered permanently by the wielder of this dagger, who fell to the corruption and attacked his legion during a great corrupted siege.

506c6ca4d96c.src: The name has got to be misspelled... It doesn't even make any sense!
506c6ca4d96c.dst: 這名字一定是拼錯了……根本連意思都不通！
506c6ca4d96c.flat: The name has got to be misspelled... It doesn't even make any sense!

e24891a01db7.src: The once-chief of the Iboju tribe held a sacred duty: a revitalizing defense of the jungle, reducing smoldering bones of invaders to rich ash that fed the soil. Yet, as the undead plight wore on, duty curdled into obsession. He became the very monster he sought to destroy, seeing horrors in every living soul and purging them for a land he lost his mind to save.
e24891a01db7.dst: Iboju 部族的前任酋長背負著一項神聖的職責：以一種能使叢林復甦的方式防衛它——把入侵者悶燒的骨骸化為滋養土壤的肥沃灰燼。然而隨著亡者之禍持續蔓延，職責變質成了執念。他成了自己想摧毀的那頭怪物，在每一個活著的靈魂身上看見恐怖，並為了一片他已經瘋掉才想拯救的土地，把它們一一清洗殆盡。
e24891a01db7.flat: The once-chief of the Iboju tribe held a sacred duty: a revitalizing defense of the jungle, reducing smoldering bones of invaders to rich ash that fed the soil. Yet, as the undead plight wore on, duty curdled into obsession. He became the very monster he sought to destroy, seeing horrors in every living soul and purging them for a land he lost his mind to save.

cd61c934660e.src: Roll the dice, hit a match. You never miss.
cd61c934660e.dst: 擲下骰子，湊成一對。你從不失手。
cd61c934660e.flat: Roll the dice, hit a match. You never miss.

660c104efd28.src: The real power in madness comes not from some supernatural vigour, but from a sudden lack of interest in self-preservation, and the ensuing ability to do whatever you want.
660c104efd28.dst: 瘋狂真正的力量並非來自什麼超自然的活力，而是來自對自我保存的突然失去興趣，以及隨之而來的、想做什麼就做什麼的能力。
660c104efd28.flat: The real power in madness comes not from some supernatural vigour, but from a sudden lack of interest in self-preservation, and the ensuing ability to do whatever you want.

c3280407eb3d.src: The mirror at the core of this artefact reflects back an image of a citadel that does not exist anywhere on this planet.
c3280407eb3d.dst: 這件遺物核心的那面鏡子，映回來的是一座城塞的影像——而那座城塞在這顆星球上任何地方都不存在。
c3280407eb3d.flat: The mirror at the core of this artefact reflects back an image of a citadel that does not exist anywhere on this planet.

1b54237bf399.src: From the Nether Gate, a shard of cosmic stone was ejected. Its purity was defiled, and the first man to wield it went mad, raving about the fall of the cosmos' beauty.
1b54237bf399.dst: 一塊宇宙之石從下界之門被拋射出來。它的純淨遭到玷污，第一個握住它的人隨即發狂，口中不斷囈語著宇宙之美的殞落。
1b54237bf399.flat: From the Nether Gate, a shard of cosmic stone was ejected. Its purity was defiled, and the first man to wield it went mad, raving about the fall of the cosmos' beauty.

f36718ae8fcb.src: Your soul is stained. Covered in the dirt of deceit and the muck of murder, the sins haunt your every step. Burn it all away, purify your existence in a flash of brilliant light.
f36718ae8fcb.dst: 你的靈魂被玷污了。覆滿了欺瞞的塵與殺戮的污，罪孽糾纏著你每一步。把它們全燒盡吧，在一道燦爛的光中淨化你的存在。
f36718ae8fcb.flat: Your soul is stained. Covered in the dirt of deceit and the muck of murder, the sins haunt your every step. Burn it all away, purify your existence in a flash of brilliant light.

d2da021d616c.src: "Only the most wicked in Gavel could dream of a circumstance as what plagues this Wynn province." -King of {p}
d2da021d616c.dst: 「就算是 Gavel 最邪惡的人，也想像不出 Wynn 行省現在遭受的這種光景。」——{p} 國王
d2da021d616c.flat: "Only the most wicked in Gavel could dream of a circumstance as what plagues this Wynn province." -King of {p}
d2da021d616c._raw: "Only the most wicked in Gavel could dream of a circumstance as what plagues this Wynn province." -King of Ragni

cc78ba0fdd80.src: Lost by master sailor Carvel in a massive storm, it was carried all the way out to the city of {p}, where it was found spewing seafoam and lightning bolts.
cc78ba0fdd80.dst: 航海大師 Carvel 在一場巨大的風暴中把它弄丟了；它一路被沖到 {p} 城，被人發現時正噴著海沫與閃電。
cc78ba0fdd80.flat: Lost by master sailor Carvel in a massive storm, it was carried all the way out to the city of {p}, where it was found spewing seafoam and lightning bolts.
cc78ba0fdd80._raw: Lost by master sailor Carvel in a massive storm, it was carried all the way out to the city of Selchar, where it was found spewing seafoam and lightning bolts.

6adbb5917cb9.src: You wouldn't even think of committing these atrocities, would you? But what if you weren't the one in control?
6adbb5917cb9.dst: 這些暴行你連想都不會想去做，對吧？但如果掌控你的人不是你自己呢？
6adbb5917cb9.flat: You wouldn't even think of committing these atrocities, would you? But what if you weren't the one in control?

3aae24b19e1d.src: This short spear was the first weapon to be produced by the villagers for sale. They are old, but strong.
3aae24b19e1d.dst: 這柄短矛是村民最早生產來出售的武器。它們很舊，但很堅固。
3aae24b19e1d.flat: This short spear was the first weapon to be produced by the villagers for sale. They are old, but strong.

9631a4bc8f13.src: Aloft among the rafters of the crowded theatre a grin crept from ear to ear. Dim the lights. Tick. Raise the curtains. Tick. This shall be their final act. Tick.
9631a4bc8f13.dst: 在擠滿人的劇院屋樑之上，一抹笑意咧到了耳根。把燈調暗。滴答。拉起布幕。滴答。這將是他們的最後一幕。滴答。
9631a4bc8f13.flat: Aloft among the rafters of the crowded theatre a grin crept from ear to ear. Dim the lights. Tick. Raise the curtains. Tick. This shall be their final act. Tick.

c48d374dde27.src: They tense. They know they must hide. The bow will see to it. You will seek. You will find them. The bow will see to it. They will heed your call. They will know your face. The bow will see to it.
c48d374dde27.dst: 他們繃緊了身子。他們知道自己必須躲起來。弓會處理好的。你將追尋。你將找到他們。弓會處理好的。他們會回應你的呼喚。他們會認得你的臉。弓會處理好的。
c48d374dde27.flat: They tense. They know they must hide. The bow will see to it. You will seek. You will find them. The bow will see to it. They will heed your call. They will know your face. The bow will see to it.

e0e9a7b609b5.src: Spiritual enlightenment is a goal that many monks hope to one day grasp the barest glimpse of, often thought to be a goal that must be worked towards over a lifetime. Holding this polished, translucent blade will instantly induce that lofty state until it is let go.
e0e9a7b609b5.dst: 靈性的開悟是許多僧侶畢生盼望能窺見一絲的境地，一般認為那是得用一輩子去修的功課。而握住這片打磨得晶瑩剔透的刃，會讓人瞬間進入那個崇高的狀態——直到鬆手為止。
e0e9a7b609b5.flat: Spiritual enlightenment is a goal that many monks hope to one day grasp the barest glimpse of, often thought to be a goal that must be worked towards over a lifetime. Holding this polished, translucent blade will instantly induce that lofty state until it is let go.

d6298cf1cbc3.src: When one has climbed the highest mountain, traversed the vastest plain, what is left to conquer? One challenges the human limit, and attempts to push beyond what any has accomplished before. Sculpted in honor of the first champion, this idol emboldens you to best your greatest opponent: yourself.
d6298cf1cbc3.dst: 當一個人已經登上最高的山、走遍最遼闊的原野，還剩下什麼可以征服？他會去挑戰人的極限，試著推過任何人曾抵達的地方。這尊雕像是為紀念第一位冠軍而塑，它會鼓舞你去勝過你最強大的對手：你自己。
d6298cf1cbc3.flat: When one has climbed the highest mountain, traversed the vastest plain, what is left to conquer? One challenges the human limit, and attempts to push beyond what any has accomplished before. Sculpted in honor of the first champion, this idol emboldens you to best your greatest opponent: yourself.

ff57dfe1e93a.src: Carved directly from the mysterious rock that hit Gavel {~} years ago, this pure white wand glows with cosmic energy unknown.
ff57dfe1e93a.dst: 直接從 {~} 年前墜落 Gavel 的那塊神祕岩石上雕出，這根純白的法杖散發著不明的宇宙能量。
ff57dfe1e93a.flat: Carved directly from the mysterious rock that hit Gavel {~} years ago, this pure white wand glows with cosmic energy unknown.
ff57dfe1e93a._raw: Carved directly from the mysterious rock that hit Gavel 50 years ago, this pure white wand glows with cosmic energy unknown.

7961232d3281.src: The existence of all things is reflected in the otherworldly jewels of this grand staff, dense enough to have its own gravitational pull. Users have reported their limbs being stretched after usage.
7961232d3281.dst: 萬物的存在都映照在這根宏大長杖的異界寶石之中，而它的密度大到足以產生自己的引力。有使用者回報說，用過之後自己的四肢被拉長了。
7961232d3281.flat: The existence of all things is reflected in the otherworldly jewels of this grand staff, dense enough to have its own gravitational pull. Users have reported their limbs being stretched after usage.

1db9feb273f1.src: The Elves managed to harness the power of air itself, forming a bow made entirely of air currents, allowing the user to move swift like the wind, but vulnerable to attacks.
1db9feb273f1.dst: 精靈成功駕馭了空氣本身的力量，做出一把完全由氣流構成的弓；它讓使用者能如風一般迅捷，卻也讓他在攻擊面前毫無防備。
1db9feb273f1.flat: The Elves managed to harness the power of air itself, forming a bow made entirely of air currents, allowing the user to move swift like the wind, but vulnerable to attacks.

f592b02299ef.src: "Controlled burns are healthy, but it's clear why no one wants to do them." -Darek, Alekin Trailblazer
f592b02299ef.dst: 「控制性焚燒對森林是好事，不過為什麼沒人想做這件事也很明顯。」—Darek，Alekin 拓路者
f592b02299ef.flat: "Controlled burns are healthy, but it's clear why no one wants to do them." -Darek, Alekin Trailblazer

d42b6bb4ae03.src: "If you squish a spider egg, sometimes little spiders pop out. So, squish the whole area instead!" -Captain Fenor, {p} Legion
d42b6bb4ae03.dst: 「你要是壓爛一顆蜘蛛卵，有時候會有小蜘蛛跑出來。所以啊，直接把整片壓爛就對了！」—Captain Fenor，{p} 軍團
d42b6bb4ae03.flat: "If you squish a spider egg, sometimes little spiders pop out. So, squish the whole area instead!" -Captain Fenor, {p} Legion
d42b6bb4ae03._raw: "If you squish a spider egg, sometimes little spiders pop out. So, squish the whole area instead!" -Captain Fenor, Detlas Legion

ac27f2892162.src: When the two opposing Realms come to blows, War lashes out with blind enmity. Such is the nature of a Devil, each born from the hate those two Beasts bear.
ac27f2892162.dst: 當兩個對立的界域刀兵相見，戰爭便帶著盲目的敵意四處揮打。惡魔的本質正是如此——每一隻都誕生自那兩頭巨獸彼此懷抱的恨意。
ac27f2892162.flat: When the two opposing Realms come to blows, War lashes out with blind enmity. Such is the nature of a Devil, each born from the hate those two Beasts bear.

8f042824ad67.src: The two mesa tribes once were allies until their sacred totems were stolen. Before that time, however, they often shared their talents, and this bow hewn from mesa stone was one such lost craft.
8f042824ad67.dst: 兩個台地部族曾經是盟友，直到他們的神聖圖騰被偷走為止。在那之前，他們常常互相分享技藝，而這把以台地岩石削成的弓，正是其中一件已然失傳的工藝。
8f042824ad67.flat: The two mesa tribes once were allies until their sacred totems were stolen. Before that time, however, they often shared their talents, and this bow hewn from mesa stone was one such lost craft.

11577d6c7b25.src: "I have to wonder just how healthy slime found in the depths of a desert  cavern can be to drink." -Eluzterp, {p} resident
11577d6c7b25.dst: 「我實在很好奇，從沙漠洞窟深處撈出來的黏液，喝下去到底能有多健康。」—Eluzterp，{p} 居民
11577d6c7b25.flat: "I have to wonder just how healthy slime found in the depths of a desert  cavern can be to drink." -Eluzterp, {p} resident
11577d6c7b25._raw: "I have to wonder just how healthy slime found in the depths of a desert  cavern can be to drink." -Eluzterp, Almuj resident

f9620af3ee48.src: To hunt in the {p} is always an opportunity. Perhaps hidden between the trees, behind the shrubs, above the canopy, or even within the shadows just behind you, mirroring your every step.
f9620af3ee48.dst: 在 {p} 狩獵永遠都是個機會。也許就藏在樹與樹之間、灌木叢後面、樹冠之上，甚至就在你背後的陰影裡，一步一步照著你走。
f9620af3ee48.flat: To hunt in the {p} is always an opportunity. Perhaps hidden between the trees, behind the shrubs, above the canopy, or even within the shadows just behind you, mirroring your every step.
f9620af3ee48._raw: To hunt in the Mistwoods is always an opportunity. Perhaps hidden between the trees, behind the shrubs, above the canopy, or even within the shadows just behind you, mirroring your every step.

93cd72411ef7.src: This wand merges with the user on touch, bringing about horrific changes to them. Elongated nails, sharp teeth and the ability to breathe fire are trademarks of the beast.
93cd72411ef7.dst: 這根魔杖一經觸碰便會與使用者融為一體，帶來種種可怖的變化。過長的指甲、尖銳的獠牙，以及吐出火焰的能力，都是那頭野獸的標記。
93cd72411ef7.flat: This wand merges with the user on touch, bringing about horrific changes to them. Elongated nails, sharp teeth and the ability to breathe fire are trademarks of the beast.

a3febb81bebc.src: One of many lost artifacts from the legendary Wind Fortress, the engraving appears to be a cryptic clue to where the Fortress fell. "We shall be found among the dark winds of the morrow."
a3febb81bebc.dst: 風之要塞眾多失落遺物之一；上面的刻字看起來像是關於要塞墜落之處的一則謎樣線索：「我們將在明日的暗風之中被尋見。」
a3febb81bebc.flat: One of many lost artifacts from the legendary Wind Fortress, the engraving appears to be a cryptic clue to where the Fortress fell. "We shall be found among the dark winds of the morrow."

95a064f8fe88.src: The world revolves around you, after all. It's high time you spread the news!
95a064f8fe88.dst: 世界本來就是繞著你轉的。是時候把這個消息傳出去了！
95a064f8fe88.flat: The world revolves around you, after all. It's high time you spread the news!

1ec7a4591360.src: A year-long monsoon soaked this {p}-made bow so much, that it has harnessed the very essence of water.
1ec7a4591360.dst: 一場持續一年的季風把這把 {p} 製的弓浸透到了極點，讓它掌握了水的本質本身。
1ec7a4591360.flat: A year-long monsoon soaked this {p}-made bow so much, that it has harnessed the very essence of water.
1ec7a4591360._raw: A year-long monsoon soaked this Nemract-made bow so much, that it has harnessed the very essence of water.

542f9b83b08f.src: Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and immense wisdom meld to create a commanding aura, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for dominion over all.
542f9b83b08f.dst: 銘刻的 Uth 符文之力與龐大的智慧交融，形成一股威嚴的氣場；這件武器不過是使用者「統御一切」這份意志在現實中的延伸。
542f9b83b08f.flat: Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and immense wisdom meld to create a commanding aura, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for dominion over all.

51badd535130.src: A string so subtle it can slip by the walls of reality, bringing its targets into the space beyond space itself.
51badd535130.dst: 一條細微到能溜過現實之壁的弦，把它的目標帶往空間本身之外的那片空間。
51badd535130.flat: A string so subtle it can slip by the walls of reality, bringing its targets into the space beyond space itself.

6e8339a5149c.src: A bow drawn from the air itself. It imbues the wielder with all the spirit of the wind.
6e8339a5149c.dst: 一把自空氣本身抽出的弓。它把風的全部靈性灌注給持有者。
6e8339a5149c.flat: A bow drawn from the air itself. It imbues the wielder with all the spirit of the wind.

5a8d7c73e255.src: The diminutive stature of this item belies its abilities. Absorbing and expelling magical energy in precise bursts, it protects the user from all manner of attacks while punishing those who dare strike.
5a8d7c73e255.dst: 這件物品小巧的外形掩蓋了它的能耐。它會吸收魔法能量，再以精準的短促爆發吐回；既護著使用者不受各種攻擊所傷，也懲罰每一個膽敢出手的人。
5a8d7c73e255.flat: The diminutive stature of this item belies its abilities. Absorbing and expelling magical energy in precise bursts, it protects the user from all manner of attacks while punishing those who dare strike.

e8cdf2d0d95c.src: This sacrificial kris, fallen from the peak of the {p}, is completely hollow. To wield it is to invite to yourself the same hollowness. To become such an aberration, to unwrite yourself in pursuit of power...it must be fed of its wielder til only the barest existence remains.
e8cdf2d0d95c.dst: 這把從 {p} 峰頂墜落的獻祭之刃，內部完全中空。握住它，等於是把同樣的空洞請進自己體內。要成為那樣的異物，要為了追求力量而把自己一筆一筆抹去……它必須以持有者為食，直到只剩下最勉強的一點存在為止。
e8cdf2d0d95c.flat: This sacrificial kris, fallen from the peak of the {p}, is completely hollow. To wield it is to invite to yourself the same hollowness. To become such an aberration, to unwrite yourself in pursuit of power...it must be fed of its wielder til only the barest existence remains.
e8cdf2d0d95c._raw: This sacrificial kris, fallen from the peak of the Tower of Ascension, is completely hollow. To wield it is to invite to yourself the same hollowness. To become such an aberration, to unwrite yourself in pursuit of power...it must be fed of its wielder til only the barest existence remains.

facb4a814129.src: This ornate knife, which fell from {p} centuries ago, is still followed by the shadows of the void, blotting out the sun in a wide area around it. Bathed in the darkness of twilight, you finally feel truly liberated, as no soul will ever see the horrors you commit.
facb4a814129.dst: 這把幾世紀前自 {p} 墜落的華麗小刀，至今仍被虛空的陰影追隨著，在它周圍一大片區域裡遮蔽了太陽。沐浴在黃昏的黑暗裡，你終於覺得自己真正自由了——因為再也不會有任何靈魂看見你所犯下的恐怖之事。
facb4a814129.flat: This ornate knife, which fell from {p} centuries ago, is still followed by the shadows of the void, blotting out the sun in a wide area around it. Bathed in the darkness of twilight, you finally feel truly liberated, as no soul will ever see the horrors you commit.
facb4a814129._raw: This ornate knife, which fell from Ahmsord centuries ago, is still followed by the shadows of the void, blotting out the sun in a wide area around it. Bathed in the darkness of twilight, you finally feel truly liberated, as no soul will ever see the horrors you commit.

97a077f14f60.src: "If anyone finds this, leave it at my Gale's gravesite. I promised her a memento, too." This inscription is extremely weathered.
97a077f14f60.dst: 「若有人找到這個，請把它留在我的 Gale 墓前。我也答應過她一份紀念。」這段刻字風化得相當嚴重。
97a077f14f60.flat: "If anyone finds this, leave it at my Gale's gravesite. I promised her a memento, too." This inscription is extremely weathered.

0afafb0da755.src: This expertly crafted bow was whittled by a cryptid-researching fanatic. Its frame was cut from the very toughest tree roots.
0afafb0da755.dst: 這把做工精湛的弓出自一位痴迷於神祕生物研究的狂熱者之手。弓身取自最堅韌的樹根。
0afafb0da755.flat: This expertly crafted bow was whittled by a cryptid-researching fanatic. Its frame was cut from the very toughest tree roots.

80b86c77ac2a.src: This expertly crafted dagger was smithed by a cryptid-researching fanatic. It can chop through even the thickest of the swamp's clay with ease.
80b86c77ac2a.dst: 這把做工精湛的匕首出自一位痴迷於神祕生物研究的狂熱者之手。就連沼澤裡最厚的黏土它都能輕易劈開。
80b86c77ac2a.flat: This expertly crafted dagger was smithed by a cryptid-researching fanatic. It can chop through even the thickest of the swamp's clay with ease.

b219c0201899.src: This expertly crafted relik was notched by a cryptid-researching fanatic. Its feathers and baubles chime with a soothing melody.
b219c0201899.dst: 這件做工精湛的法器出自一位痴迷於神祕生物研究的狂熱者之手。上面的羽飾與小墜子會發出令人安定的旋律。
b219c0201899.flat: This expertly crafted relik was notched by a cryptid-researching fanatic. Its feathers and baubles chime with a soothing melody.

e9688f721878.src: This expertly crafted spear was forged by a cryptid-researching fanatic. It shines brilliantly in even the weakest sunlight.
e9688f721878.dst: 這桿做工精湛的矛出自一位痴迷於神祕生物研究的狂熱者之手。即使在最微弱的日光下它也閃耀奪目。
e9688f721878.flat: This expertly crafted spear was forged by a cryptid-researching fanatic. It shines brilliantly in even the weakest sunlight.

26c904b0c255.src: This expertly crafted wand was shaped by a cryptid-researching fanatic. It shimmers with the purest water from the swamp.
26c904b0c255.dst: 這根做工精湛的魔杖出自一位痴迷於神祕生物研究的狂熱者之手。它閃爍著沼澤裡最純淨的水光。
26c904b0c255.flat: This expertly crafted wand was shaped by a cryptid-researching fanatic. It shimmers with the purest water from the swamp.

9acc2446d487.src: Everything dies. Show those who resist the foolishness of their ambitions.It's pulling towards something.
9acc2446d487.dst: 萬物皆死。讓那些負隅頑抗的人看清自己的野心有多可笑。它正被某種東西牽引著。
9acc2446d487.flat: Everything dies. Show those who resist the foolishness of their ambitions.It's pulling towards something.

c8818c7f32a3.src: True artistry takes time... with the power to sculpt mountains and erode cliffsides into panoramas, the beliefs of your enemies are insignificant. They will understand your greatness... in due time.
c8818c7f32a3.dst: 真正的藝術需要時間……當你擁有雕塑山脈、把崖壁侵蝕成全景畫的力量時，敵人的信念根本無足輕重。他們會明白你的偉大……時候到了自然會。
c8818c7f32a3.flat: True artistry takes time... with the power to sculpt mountains and erode cliffsides into panoramas, the beliefs of your enemies are insignificant. They will understand your greatness... in due time.

ca91d9446113.src: Holding this relik sends sparks through your veins, making your heart beat fast. And faster. And faster and faster and--
ca91d9446113.dst: 握住這件法器，電花會竄過你的血管，讓你的心跳加快。再更快。更快更快然後——
ca91d9446113.flat: Holding this relik sends sparks through your veins, making your heart beat fast. And faster. And faster and faster and--

a5caee4f656e.src: They must know what you went through. They must suffer the same as you did.
a5caee4f656e.dst: 他們必須知道你經歷過什麼。他們必須嘗到和你一樣的苦。
a5caee4f656e.flat: They must know what you went through. They must suffer the same as you did.

9aeb117fad98.src: Faces have danced around you as long as you can remember, laughing, jeering, mocking. This is your surrender, casting faces of your own into the theatre of your humiliation.
9aeb117fad98.dst: 從你記得的時候起，一張張臉就在你周圍起舞、大笑、譏諷、嘲弄。這是你的投降——把你自己的臉，也一併投進這座羞辱的劇場裡。
9aeb117fad98.flat: Faces have danced around you as long as you can remember, laughing, jeering, mocking. This is your surrender, casting faces of your own into the theatre of your humiliation.

18eddd5d2d10.src: "I am only human in the snow. When it melts away, so too do I, for then I am cursed to be a swan."
18eddd5d2d10.dst: 「唯有在雪中，我才是人。雪一融，我也隨之消失——因為那時我便受詛成為一隻天鵝。」
18eddd5d2d10.flat: "I am only human in the snow. When it melts away, so too do I, for then I am cursed to be a swan."

597eab860aa9.src: The song of the world begins as a quiet whistle, calm and peaceful, wrapping 'round the trees and drifting lazily across the fields. It is ever so soft, yet sharper than any sword.
597eab860aa9.dst: 世界之歌始於一聲輕柔的口哨，平靜而安詳，繞過樹木、慵懶地飄過原野。它是如此柔軟，卻比任何劍都鋒利。
597eab860aa9.flat: The song of the world begins as a quiet whistle, calm and peaceful, wrapping 'round the trees and drifting lazily across the fields. It is ever so soft, yet sharper than any sword.

794057f9a8a2.src: Her crimes were against Decency. She laughed and spat, denying reason and making the world suffer for small vengeance.
794057f9a8a2.dst: 她的罪行是對著體面。她大笑、她啐口水，否定一切道理，只為一點小小的報復就讓世界受苦。
794057f9a8a2.flat: Her crimes were against Decency. She laughed and spat, denying reason and making the world suffer for small vengeance.

37e3b76b9604.src: The magically rejuvenating properties of phoenix ash were imbued into this grand stave in its creator's bid to gain immortality.
37e3b76b9604.dst: 鳳凰之灰那具有魔法回春之效的特性，被灌注進這根宏偉的長杖裡——那是它的創造者追求不朽的嘗試。
37e3b76b9604.flat: The magically rejuvenating properties of phoenix ash were imbued into this grand stave in its creator's bid to gain immortality.

fcce8fc85d40.src: Carried by the {p} Plague Doctor, this simple-looking stick subtly oozes with an unidentifiable substance that is invigorating to the holder, and lethally venomous to anything else.
fcce8fc85d40.dst: 由 {p} 的瘟疫醫生所持。這根外表平凡的杖悄悄滲著某種無法辨識的物質，對持有者是滋補，對其他任何東西則是致命的劇毒。
fcce8fc85d40.flat: Carried by the {p} Plague Doctor, this simple-looking stick subtly oozes with an unidentifiable substance that is invigorating to the holder, and lethally venomous to anything else.
fcce8fc85d40._raw: Carried by the Olux Plague Doctor, this simple-looking stick subtly oozes with an unidentifiable substance that is invigorating to the holder, and lethally venomous to anything else.

d6e8416ea89f.src: With each swing, this ornate hammer threatens to shape mountains and carve valleys, cleaving new fault lines in a single blow.
d6e8416ea89f.dst: 每揮出一擊，這柄華麗的鎚都彷彿要塑出山脈、鑿出谷地，一擊之間便劈出新的斷層線。
d6e8416ea89f.flat: With each swing, this ornate hammer threatens to shape mountains and carve valleys, cleaving new fault lines in a single blow.

be3b65f4d1ef.src: Wielding this molten sword, you feel your worries and empathy combust away into corrosive smoke. If one can feel so free, why should it matter if it comes to the detriment of the world around you?
be3b65f4d1ef.dst: 揮動這把熔融之劍，你會感覺自己的憂慮與同理心一併燒成了腐蝕性的煙。既然人能如此自由，那就算代價是你周遭的世界，又何妨？
be3b65f4d1ef.flat: Wielding this molten sword, you feel your worries and empathy combust away into corrosive smoke. If one can feel so free, why should it matter if it comes to the detriment of the world around you?

25ee3d7aab55.src: This spear is bright enough that it can cause blindness if you look directly at it. Its immense power is limited by its weight; the weapon is nearly impossible to lift.
25ee3d7aab55.dst: 這桿矛亮到你直視它就會失明。它龐大的力量受限於自身的重量；這件武器幾乎舉不起來。
25ee3d7aab55.flat: This spear is bright enough that it can cause blindness if you look directly at it. Its immense power is limited by its weight; the weapon is nearly impossible to lift.

16cdc05a6280.src: This staff was expertly crafted from fragile spun glass, and tinted with various magical foci that bend light into its most raw components.
16cdc05a6280.dst: 這根長杖以脆弱的吹製玻璃精工製成，並以各種魔法聚焦體染色，能把光折成最原始的組成成分。
16cdc05a6280.flat: This staff was expertly crafted from fragile spun glass, and tinted with various magical foci that bend light into its most raw components.

c0bc54380346.src: The density of this weapon is almost immeasurable. Despite being light and easy to wield, the spear seems to have its own gravitational pull, slowly dragging enemies closer and making it nearly impossible to put down.
c0bc54380346.dst: 這件武器的密度幾乎無法測量。儘管它輕盈易用，這桿矛似乎有自己的引力，會慢慢把敵人拖近，也讓人幾乎不可能把它放下。
c0bc54380346.flat: The density of this weapon is almost immeasurable. Despite being light and easy to wield, the spear seems to have its own gravitational pull, slowly dragging enemies closer and making it nearly impossible to put down.

34583d2f6e45.src: "Leave us down here to die, why don't you all. Just turn us into another statistic and be done, huh?" -Ragamal, {p} Sewer Dweller
34583d2f6e45.dst: 「讓我們死在這下面好了，你們何不就這樣呢。把我們變成另一個統計數字，然後結束，是吧？」—Ragamal，{p} 下水道住民
34583d2f6e45.flat: "Leave us down here to die, why don't you all. Just turn us into another statistic and be done, huh?" -Ragamal, {p} Sewer Dweller
34583d2f6e45._raw: "Leave us down here to die, why don't you all. Just turn us into another statistic and be done, huh?" -Ragamal, Nemract Sewer Dweller

ee9b80fbd99b.src: "I always thought Yahya was venom-addled, but the symptoms don't match..." -Pyeka, Alekin Herbalist
ee9b80fbd99b.dst: 「我一直以為 Yahya 是被毒素搞壞了腦子，可是症狀對不上……」—Pyeka，Alekin 草藥師
ee9b80fbd99b.flat: "I always thought Yahya was venom-addled, but the symptoms don't match..." -Pyeka, Alekin Herbalist

0fb197bb23e1.src: The great serpent of Ahms was said to be a bringer of wisdom in days long past, revered by the inhabitants of the region. Totems like this one were crafted as an act of worship, though as belief faded over time, so too were these idols lost and destroyed. Only one remains.
0fb197bb23e1.dst: 傳說在很久以前，Ahms 的巨蛇是帶來智慧的存在，受到當地居民的崇敬。像這樣的圖騰是作為敬拜之物而製；然而信仰隨時間褪去，這些神像也一併散佚、毀壞。如今只剩下一尊。
0fb197bb23e1.flat: The great serpent of Ahms was said to be a bringer of wisdom in days long past, revered by the inhabitants of the region. Totems like this one were crafted as an act of worship, though as belief faded over time, so too were these idols lost and destroyed. Only one remains.

79115aa3af69.src: A spear hewn from a radioactive metal. It may be toxic for the wielder, but it is fatal to its enemies.
79115aa3af69.dst: 一桿以放射性金屬削成的矛。它對持有者或許有毒，對敵人則是致命的。
79115aa3af69.flat: A spear hewn from a radioactive metal. It may be toxic for the wielder, but it is fatal to its enemies.

c615fa8d2bee.src: A grave digger uncovered this blade from the resting place of a notorious pirate that pillaged the islands of the ocean for four decades.
c615fa8d2bee.dst: 一名掘墓人從一位惡名昭彰的海盜長眠之處挖出了這把刃；那名海盜曾劫掠這片海洋上的島嶼長達四十年。
c615fa8d2bee.flat: A grave digger uncovered this blade from the resting place of a notorious pirate that pillaged the islands of the ocean for four decades.

5b661fd5bdd1.src: To call an end a new beginning implies there ever was a beginning, or ever will be an end.
5b661fd5bdd1.dst: 把終點稱為新的起點，等於是假設曾經有過起點，或終究會有終點。
5b661fd5bdd1.flat: To call an end a new beginning implies there ever was a beginning, or ever will be an end.

4ccbc568bb9b.src: The flickering flame atop this simple wand is a marvel of magic. It always burns at a comfortable heat, cannot scorch skin even if touched, and never can be snuffed out under any circumstance.
4ccbc568bb9b.dst: 這根樸素魔杖頂端搖曳的火焰是魔法的奇蹟。它永遠燒在舒適的溫度，就算碰到也燒不傷皮膚，而且在任何情況下都無法被熄滅。
4ccbc568bb9b.flat: The flickering flame atop this simple wand is a marvel of magic. It always burns at a comfortable heat, cannot scorch skin even if touched, and never can be snuffed out under any circumstance.

5c6d36611b19.src: Finally, the pulse of melody and harmony flies through golden halls, flung by the momentum of life itself. A single knock of polished wood on chiselled stone, and the song of the world falls silent.
5c6d36611b19.dst: 終於，旋律與和聲的脈動飛過金色的長廊，由生命本身的動能推送著。一記磨亮的木頭敲在鑿好的石上，世界之歌隨即歸於寂靜。
5c6d36611b19.flat: Finally, the pulse of melody and harmony flies through golden halls, flung by the momentum of life itself. A single knock of polished wood on chiselled stone, and the song of the world falls silent.

168e6ecb7f22.src: Despite being proven unrelated, this enigmatic bow was the lynchpin to beginning the great search for the Relics.
168e6ecb7f22.dst: 儘管後來被證實毫無關聯，這把謎樣的弓，正是那場尋找遺物大搜索的開端關鍵。
168e6ecb7f22.flat: Despite being proven unrelated, this enigmatic bow was the lynchpin to beginning the great search for the Relics.

e9d401cb9bad.src: Despite this mace never seeing use by Remikas, it was seen as a symbol of the might of his rule over Gavel. Its true abilities in battle have never been seen.
e9d401cb9bad.dst: 儘管 Remikas 從未真正使用過這柄權杖，它仍被視為他統治 Gavel 之威權的象徵。它在戰場上的真正能耐，從來沒有人見識過。
e9d401cb9bad.flat: Despite this mace never seeing use by Remikas, it was seen as a symbol of the might of his rule over Gavel. Its true abilities in battle have never been seen.

2a03ab014f0b.src: "Skin worked so thin, we see the bone; she grinds us up from on her throne. Their houses made of flimsy steel; scars from bombs will never heal."
2a03ab014f0b.dst: 「皮被磨得那樣薄，露出了骨；她高踞王座把我們碾成粉。他們的房子用的是不堪一擊的鐵皮；炸彈留下的疤永遠好不了。」
2a03ab014f0b.flat: "Skin worked so thin, we see the bone; she grinds us up from on her throne. Their houses made of flimsy steel; scars from bombs will never heal."

b27d3c431f7a.src: Her crimes were against the State. She burned and pillaged, making a mockery of law and civility throughout the land.
b27d3c431f7a.dst: 她的罪行是對著國家。她焚燒、她劫掠，把這片土地上的法律與文明徹底當成了笑話。
b27d3c431f7a.flat: Her crimes were against the State. She burned and pillaged, making a mockery of law and civility throughout the land.

c294b91bdf17.src: The power to join oneself with the lifeblood of the earth has long eluded sects of fanatical druids and shamans. One such cult found a way, and subsequently wiped itself out in the process, their flesh turning to stone and veins forming new rivers.
c294b91bdf17.dst: 與大地的生命之血合而為一——這份力量長久以來一直躲著那些狂熱的德魯伊與薩滿教派。其中一支終於找到了方法，也因此在過程中把自己整支滅絕：他們的血肉化為岩石，血管成了新的河流。
c294b91bdf17.flat: The power to join oneself with the lifeblood of the earth has long eluded sects of fanatical druids and shamans. One such cult found a way, and subsequently wiped itself out in the process, their flesh turning to stone and veins forming new rivers.

e5e8c3aa7436.src: recnal il il. alac toc, pasad il, atlruc il, kaclahpokc il cefos. lahes il nikcrolad kec pahsofmal uc ifrah tofnikcsif. etlefrofmad uc, etlaces uc tofnikcsoftahal. rofmel lahrakctriltod uc tofpahnuc. lahic cof efrofmad il pahsadiled uc tofifrah. etlalnes ah rofmedes uc tofpestal. pasad uc tofmahatskritsec. etlrakc kec. etlrakc kec.
e5e8c3aa7436.flat: recnal il il. alac toc, pasad il, atlruc il, kaclahpokc il cefos. lahes il nikcrolad kec pahsofmal uc ifrah tofnikcsif. etlefrofmad uc, etlaces uc tofnikcsoftahal. rofmel lahrakctriltod uc tofpahnuc. lahic cof efrofmad il pahsadiled uc tofifrah. etlalnes ah rofmedes uc tofpestal. pasad uc tofmahatskritsec. etlrakc kec. etlrakc kec.

517acaf29bad.src: Many old mages had to perform lengthy incantations to make potent even their simplest spells. A mage cursed to be mute, however, brought upon a revolution to spellcasting through this simple wand.
517acaf29bad.dst: 許多古代法師即使要施展最簡單的法術，也得念上一長串咒文。然而一位受詛而無法言語的法師，藉著這根簡樸的法杖，為施法方式帶來了一場革命。
517acaf29bad.flat: Many old mages had to perform lengthy incantations to make potent even their simplest spells. A mage cursed to be mute, however, brought upon a revolution to spellcasting through this simple wand.

1b5758c5ede7.src: There was glory in this place, once. Life, vitality, springing forth from every well and boulder. No longer. All that remains now is death, and a fleeting memory of that which once was.
1b5758c5ede7.dst: 這個地方曾經有過榮光。生命、活力，從每一口井、每一塊岩石中湧出。不再了。如今留下來的只有死亡，以及對那份曾經存在之物一閃即逝的記憶。
1b5758c5ede7.flat: There was glory in this place, once. Life, vitality, springing forth from every well and boulder. No longer. All that remains now is death, and a fleeting memory of that which once was.

95763487415f.src: This enigmatic weapon can suddenly blink out of reality with no warning only to appear exactly where it was left later. Artificers have determined that almost the entire bow, by all known laws of nature and magic, should not exist.
95763487415f.dst: 這件謎樣的武器會毫無預警地忽然自現實中消失，之後又剛好出現在被放下的原處。器械師判定，依照一切已知的自然與魔法法則，這把弓幾乎整把都不該存在。
95763487415f.flat: This enigmatic weapon can suddenly blink out of reality with no warning only to appear exactly where it was left later. Artificers have determined that almost the entire bow, by all known laws of nature and magic, should not exist.

318dc848fed7.src: A boiling rage has been gathering, the pain of an entire empire yearning to be freed. With all the power of the downtrodden and the overlooked and the starved, you echo out a shout with ten thousand voices, each too quiet to hear by itself, but together a catastrophic force to make the heavens cower.
318dc848fed7.dst: 一股沸騰的怒火早已積聚，那是整個帝國渴望掙脫的痛楚。帶著所有被踐踏、被無視、被餓著的人的力量，你發出一聲由萬人共鳴的吶喊——每一道聲音單獨聽來都太輕，合起來卻是足以讓諸天退縮的災難之力。
318dc848fed7.flat: A boiling rage has been gathering, the pain of an entire empire yearning to be freed. With all the power of the downtrodden and the overlooked and the starved, you echo out a shout with ten thousand voices, each too quiet to hear by itself, but together a catastrophic force to make the heavens cower.

5f704b0c002e.src: Time moves in strange ways around this translucent blade, speeding and slowing, starting and stopping, with no observable reasoning or pattern.
5f704b0c002e.dst: 時間在這把半透明的刃周圍以奇異的方式流動，時快時慢、時走時停，看不出任何道理或規律。
5f704b0c002e.flat: Time moves in strange ways around this translucent blade, speeding and slowing, starting and stopping, with no observable reasoning or pattern.

c586739f49b5.src: The world suffocates under pressure, the seasons decay under age. The rivers dry up and the oceans flood the land while you helplessly watch your friends drop like flies.
c586739f49b5.dst: 世界在壓力之下窒息，四季隨著年歲腐朽。河川乾涸，海洋淹沒陸地，而你只能無助地看著你的朋友一個接一個倒下。
c586739f49b5.flat: The world suffocates under pressure, the seasons decay under age. The rivers dry up and the oceans flood the land while you helplessly watch your friends drop like flies.

c3b8a375c1ac.src: After this crossbow's original wielder fell in battle, its mechanisms stiffened and locked into place. A spark of life, or undeath, can temporarily reverse the effect before the weapon seizes up again.It's pulling towards something.
c3b8a375c1ac.dst: 這把十字弓原本的持有者戰死之後，它的機構就僵硬鎖死了。一絲生命——或不死——的火花能暫時逆轉這個狀態，直到武器再次卡住為止。它正被某種東西牽引著。
c3b8a375c1ac.flat: After this crossbow's original wielder fell in battle, its mechanisms stiffened and locked into place. A spark of life, or undeath, can temporarily reverse the effect before the weapon seizes up again.It's pulling towards something.

26b7cb5d8f3f.src: Named for an ancient Wynnic word for "Earthquake", this mighty battle hammer causes the very bones of struck enemies to rattle and heave as though the earth itself was splitting under their feet.
26b7cb5d8f3f.dst: 以古 Wynn 語中「地震」一詞命名。這柄沉重的戰鎚會讓被擊中的敵人連骨頭都震顫翻騰，彷彿腳下的大地正在裂開。
26b7cb5d8f3f.flat: Named for an ancient Wynnic word for "Earthquake", this mighty battle hammer causes the very bones of struck enemies to rattle and heave as though the earth itself was splitting under their feet.

dd784084ddd4.src: The waves are not like men; they do not brazenly assault and catastrophically fail. They do not burn fast and wink out. They bide their time, they wait, and they encroach upon the world with an insidious, unstoppable force, dragging you away to the dark side of the sea.
dd784084ddd4.dst: 浪不像人；它們不會莽撞地衝上來，然後一敗塗地。它們不會燒得又快又亮，然後倏地熄滅。它們等待、蟄伏，再以一種陰險而無可阻擋的力量侵入這個世界，把你拖往大海陰暗的那一側。
dd784084ddd4.flat: The waves are not like men; they do not brazenly assault and catastrophically fail. They do not burn fast and wink out. They bide their time, they wait, and they encroach upon the world with an insidious, unstoppable force, dragging you away to the dark side of the sea.

f161caf3dcd4.src: Not knowing what's going on is the best part!
f161caf3dcd4.dst: 搞不清楚狀況才是最好玩的地方！
f161caf3dcd4.flat: Not knowing what's going on is the best part!

aa5ae93e6152.src: The first of her crimes was against the Church. She blasphemed and raved, cursing with the names of gods long-abandoned.
aa5ae93e6152.dst: 她的第一樁罪行是對著教會。她褻瀆、她狂言，以早已被棄的諸神之名詛咒一切。
aa5ae93e6152.flat: The first of her crimes was against the Church. She blasphemed and raved, cursing with the names of gods long-abandoned.

5ed09038b0aa.src: Discipline and experience is channeled into these wands for {~} years in the Bantisu monastery of the canyon, in the hope that they will pass on its teachings to less experienced users.
5ed09038b0aa.dst: 在峽谷的 Bantisu 修道院裡，紀律與經驗被灌注進這些魔杖裡整整 {~} 年，盼望它們能把院中的教誨傳給經驗尚淺的使用者。
5ed09038b0aa.flat: Discipline and experience is channeled into these wands for {~} years in the Bantisu monastery of the canyon, in the hope that they will pass on its teachings to less experienced users.
5ed09038b0aa._raw: Discipline and experience is channeled into these wands for 10 years in the Bantisu monastery of the canyon, in the hope that they will pass on its teachings to less experienced users.

9c4344ba24ff.src: "Can anyone else understand that General Graken? Because I can't." -Commander Takan, {p} Militia
9c4344ba24ff.dst: 「還有誰聽得懂那個 Graken 將軍在講什麼嗎？因為我聽不懂。」—Commander Takan，{p} 民兵
9c4344ba24ff.flat: "Can anyone else understand that General Graken? Because I can't." -Commander Takan, {p} Militia
9c4344ba24ff._raw: "Can anyone else understand that General Graken? Because I can't." -Commander Takan, Nemract Militia

0e5e2e8cbe52.src: The whispers crescendo to cackles, creeping cries clouding your mind. You can't think. They eat away at the edges of your consciousness. You can't think. It's too loud in your brain. You can't think.
0e5e2e8cbe52.dst: 低語漸強成狂笑，爬行的哭嚎蒙住了你的心智。你沒辦法思考。它們啃噬著你意識的邊緣。你沒辦法思考。你的腦子裡太吵了。你沒辦法思考。
0e5e2e8cbe52.flat: The whispers crescendo to cackles, creeping cries clouding your mind. You can't think. They eat away at the edges of your consciousness. You can't think. It's too loud in your brain. You can't think.

b32b1f669b03.src: This dagger has no blade. Instead, it is layered with the stingers of the Black Shadow Scorpion, which has the ability to vanish entirely from its prey.
b32b1f669b03.dst: 這把匕首沒有刀刃。取而代之的是一層層黑影蠍的尾刺，而那種蠍子能在獵物眼前完全消失。
b32b1f669b03.flat: This dagger has no blade. Instead, it is layered with the stingers of the Black Shadow Scorpion, which has the ability to vanish entirely from its prey.

26d24ffdd4e1.src: The melody hardens, groaning and clanking, a clash of iron on steel and a shout from a thousand trampled mouths in unison. It burns and breaks, a roar of unbridled power.
26d24ffdd4e1.dst: 旋律變得堅硬，呻吟著、鏗鏘作響，那是鐵與鋼的碰撞，是千張被踐踏的嘴齊聲吶喊。它燃燒、它碎裂，是一聲毫無節制的力量之吼。
26d24ffdd4e1.flat: The melody hardens, groaning and clanking, a clash of iron on steel and a shout from a thousand trampled mouths in unison. It burns and breaks, a roar of unbridled power.

fec7c06e07c4.src: Ooze secretes out of every inch of this quarterstaff. Is it simply just more of the slime harassing travelers in the jungle, or is there something sinister at play?It's pulling towards something.
fec7c06e07c4.dst: 黏液從這根長棍的每一寸滲出來。那到底只是騷擾叢林旅人的那種黏液，還是有什麼陰森的東西在作祟？它正被某種東西牽引著。
fec7c06e07c4.flat: Ooze secretes out of every inch of this quarterstaff. Is it simply just more of the slime harassing travelers in the jungle, or is there something sinister at play?It's pulling towards something.

c3bb95cfc10c.src: A psychopath claiming herself to be Death incarnate used this dark-bladed scythe on a killing spree that lasted over a year. It reaped hundreds of lives, including her own.
c3bb95cfc10c.dst: 一名自稱是死神化身的瘋子，用這把黑刃鐮刀展開了一場持續一年多的殺戮。它收割了數百條性命——包括她自己的。
c3bb95cfc10c.flat: A psychopath claiming herself to be Death incarnate used this dark-bladed scythe on a killing spree that lasted over a year. It reaped hundreds of lives, including her own.

657bcb2595c7.src: The light refracted through this sceptre shows you visions. You see the endless waves reflected in its rainbows, cracking hulls and drowning towns. This prism allows you to channel a fraction of the sea's potential.
657bcb2595c7.dst: 透過這根權杖折射出來的光會讓你看見異象。你在它的虹彩裡看見無盡的浪，裂開的船殼與沒頂的城鎮。這面稜鏡讓你能引導海洋潛能的一小部分。
657bcb2595c7.flat: The light refracted through this sceptre shows you visions. You see the endless waves reflected in its rainbows, cracking hulls and drowning towns. This prism allows you to channel a fraction of the sea's potential.

53a474f9caa6.src: "I bet those sewer-dwellers have horrible morning breath." -Folzoy, {p} Escort
53a474f9caa6.dst: 「我敢打賭那些下水道住民早上起來口氣一定很可怕。」—Folzoy，{p} 護衛
53a474f9caa6.flat: "I bet those sewer-dwellers have horrible morning breath." -Folzoy, {p} Escort
53a474f9caa6._raw: "I bet those sewer-dwellers have horrible morning breath." -Folzoy, Maltic Escort

f319ea195e0a.src: What chaos is born when the sun won't rise, as it lacks a sky upon which to dawn?
f319ea195e0a.dst: 當太陽連個可供破曉的天空都沒有了，那會生出什麼樣的混亂？
f319ea195e0a.flat: What chaos is born when the sun won't rise, as it lacks a sky upon which to dawn?

8067e57bae52.src: The radiance of your foes burns bright. You must emanate your brilliance in return. Cloak them in a blinding glow. Smother their luminance with yours. Then after all of their light has faded, yours will too.
8067e57bae52.dst: 你敵人的光芒燒得明亮。你必須以自己的燦爛回敬。用一道刺目的光輝把他們裹住。以你的光扼熄他們的光。然後等他們的光全數消退之後，你的也會。
8067e57bae52.flat: The radiance of your foes burns bright. You must emanate your brilliance in return. Cloak them in a blinding glow. Smother their luminance with yours. Then after all of their light has faded, yours will too.

dba174e8116b.src: There's a scrawling etched onto the handle: "UNGA BUNGA'S. NO TOUCH."
dba174e8116b.dst: 握柄上潦草地刻著：「UNGA BUNGA 的。不准碰。」
dba174e8116b.flat: There's a scrawling etched onto the handle: "UNGA BUNGA'S. NO TOUCH."

f455a29cabdd.src: An effigy built from the stones of the mantle. It crushes anything in its wake.
f455a29cabdd.dst: 一尊以地函岩石堆築而成的像。它會碾碎所過之處的一切。
f455a29cabdd.flat: An effigy built from the stones of the mantle. It crushes anything in its wake.

4d5a9f541fee.src: "Cut a web, and its owner will feel it and come out. That's your chance to strike." -Lieutenant Van, {p} {~}nd Regiment
4d5a9f541fee.dst: 「割破一張網，網主人會感覺到，然後跑出來。那就是你出手的機會。」—Lieutenant Van，{p} 第 {~} 團
4d5a9f541fee.flat: "Cut a web, and its owner will feel it and come out. That's your chance to strike." -Lieutenant Van, {p} {~}nd Regiment
4d5a9f541fee._raw: "Cut a web, and its owner will feel it and come out. That's your chance to strike." -Lieutenant Van, Detlas 2nd Regiment

bec48a3719e9.src: Wielding it for too long will leave one a desiccated husk, as this dull blade slowly absorbs all liquids around it.
bec48a3719e9.dst: 握著它太久會讓人變成一具乾癟的空殼，因為這把鈍刃會緩緩吸乾周遭所有的水分。
bec48a3719e9.flat: Wielding it for too long will leave one a desiccated husk, as this dull blade slowly absorbs all liquids around it.

0f7ca31ff7cb.src: "As much as they're terrifying, at least those lousy skeletons give us lots of bonemeal for the crops!" -Bylvis, {p} Farmer
0f7ca31ff7cb.dst: 「那些爛骷髏雖然嚇人，至少牠們給了我們一大堆骨粉可以肥田！」—Bylvis，{p} 農夫
0f7ca31ff7cb.flat: "As much as they're terrifying, at least those lousy skeletons give us lots of bonemeal for the crops!" -Bylvis, {p} Farmer
0f7ca31ff7cb._raw: "As much as they're terrifying, at least those lousy skeletons give us lots of bonemeal for the crops!" -Bylvis, Katoa Ranch Farmer

c45e7b40faab.src: The average bow can boast a range of skills, but unlike this one, not every bow can penetrate through any organic skin, including dragon hide.
c45e7b40faab.dst: 一般的弓可以誇口自己有各種本事，但不是每一把弓都能像這把一樣貫穿任何有機的皮，連龍皮也不例外。
c45e7b40faab.flat: The average bow can boast a range of skills, but unlike this one, not every bow can penetrate through any organic skin, including dragon hide.

4591048c7b21.src: "Even a corrupted would get crushed by one of these!" -Roche 'Stone-thrower' Diamant, {p} Citizen
4591048c7b21.dst: 「就算是腐化物，被這種東西砸到也會扁掉！」——「擲石者」Roche Diamant，{p} 市民
4591048c7b21.flat: "Even a corrupted would get crushed by one of these!" -Roche 'Stone-thrower' Diamant, {p} Citizen
4591048c7b21._raw: "Even a corrupted would get crushed by one of these!" -Roche 'Stone-thrower' Diamant, Ragni Citizen

1d64c7b9a77f.src: Launch into the heavens, then descend with the fury of a raging storm. Drag the sky down with you, and shatter it upon the earth in a devastating torrent of wind.
1d64c7b9a77f.dst: 衝上天際，再帶著狂暴風暴的怒意俯衝而下。把天空一併拖下來，在大地之上碎成一場毀滅性的狂風洪流。
1d64c7b9a77f.flat: Launch into the heavens, then descend with the fury of a raging storm. Drag the sky down with you, and shatter it upon the earth in a devastating torrent of wind.

247d2e82c0f5.src: Abandon your fear. Look forward. Move forward and never stop. Retreat and you will age. Hesitate and you will die.
247d2e82c0f5.dst: 拋下你的恐懼。向前看。向前走，永不停下。後退，你就會衰老。猶豫，你就會死。
247d2e82c0f5.flat: Abandon your fear. Look forward. Move forward and never stop. Retreat and you will age. Hesitate and you will die.

af92afb0cf5e.src: The spelling seems to have been botched.
af92afb0cf5e.dst: 這拼字看起來是搞砸了。
af92afb0cf5e.flat: The spelling seems to have been botched.

4a1aa25a6982.src: Many who venture into the jungle are swallowed by the thick undergrowth and are never seen again. This weapon and an accompanying skeleton were found inside the very adversary the spear was meant to vanquish as a perfect display of its owner's untimely demise.It's pulling towards something.
4a1aa25a6982.dst: 許多冒險進入叢林的人被濃密的底層植被吞沒，從此再也沒人見過。這件武器與一具伴隨的骸骨，是在那個它本該消滅的敵人體內被找到的——完美地展示了它主人那場猝不及防的死亡。它正被某種東西牽引著。
4a1aa25a6982.flat: Many who venture into the jungle are swallowed by the thick undergrowth and are never seen again. This weapon and an accompanying skeleton were found inside the very adversary the spear was meant to vanquish as a perfect display of its owner's untimely demise.It's pulling towards something.

054bc5268cf0.src: "The sun and related symbols appear quite often in these ancient glyphs.  Interesting, but unsurprising, no?" -Svin, Legend Keeper
054bc5268cf0.dst: 「太陽和相關的符號在這些古老的雕紋裡出現得相當頻繁。有意思，但也不令人意外，對吧？」—Svin，傳說守護者
054bc5268cf0.flat: "The sun and related symbols appear quite often in these ancient glyphs.  Interesting, but unsurprising, no?" -Svin, Legend Keeper

1219645299ff.src: It is an apathy born from lonely desperation with which one sends a blinding ray as their signal flare, uncaring if it hails friend or foe.
1219645299ff.dst: 那是一種生於孤獨絕望的漠然：有人就這樣射出一道刺目的光作為信號彈，根本不在乎招來的是友是敵。
1219645299ff.flat: It is an apathy born from lonely desperation with which one sends a blinding ray as their signal flare, uncaring if it hails friend or foe.

243d4abc8301.src: This pike carries an insatiable momentum. The blade darts through the air, slicing through the wind with a speed so great the air screams in protest, a roaring echo to be heard miles away.
243d4abc8301.dst: 這桿長矛帶著永不饜足的動能。刃身穿梭於空中，以極快的速度切開風，讓空氣發出抗議的尖嘯，那道轟鳴的回音數哩之外都聽得見。
243d4abc8301.flat: This pike carries an insatiable momentum. The blade darts through the air, slicing through the wind with a speed so great the air screams in protest, a roaring echo to be heard miles away.

a83029617356.src: This bow's thick string fails to shoot arrows effectively, but instead produces low frequency sound waves that erupt from the source in all directions. The sound can implode the eardrums of an enemy with a single strum.
a83029617356.dst: 這把弓的粗弦沒辦法有效射出箭矢，取而代之的是從源頭向四面八方爆發的低頻聲波。只要撥一下，那聲音就能把敵人的耳膜震破。
a83029617356.flat: This bow's thick string fails to shoot arrows effectively, but instead produces low frequency sound waves that erupt from the source in all directions. The sound can implode the eardrums of an enemy with a single strum.

271c519b6bc0.src: Do you recognize the cries before you? Those so far beneath you, forgotten by time and betrayed by history. Hear their song- of asylum lost and vengeance unfulfilled. Bring them closure.
271c519b6bc0.dst: 你認得眼前這些哭聲嗎？那些遠在你之下、被時間遺忘、被歷史背叛的人。聽聽他們的歌吧——關於失去的庇護，與未竟的復仇。給他們一個了結。
271c519b6bc0.flat: Do you recognize the cries before you? Those so far beneath you, forgotten by time and betrayed by history. Hear their song- of asylum lost and vengeance unfulfilled. Bring them closure.

6474de912f61.src: Recovered from the {p} Penitentiary, this grisly bow holds destructive capabilities. Used to carry out executions, a precise enough shot can shatter the soul of those it hits.
6474de912f61.dst: 從 {p} 監獄取回的這把駭人的弓，具備毀滅性的能耐。它曾被用來執行死刑；夠精準的一射能擊碎中箭者的靈魂。
6474de912f61.flat: Recovered from the {p} Penitentiary, this grisly bow holds destructive capabilities. Used to carry out executions, a precise enough shot can shatter the soul of those it hits.
6474de912f61._raw: Recovered from the Lexdale Penitentiary, this grisly bow holds destructive capabilities. Used to carry out executions, a precise enough shot can shatter the soul of those it hits.

737475e8f5ab.src: Arrows fired by this bow are pure ice, but when they hit the enemy, burst into magical water, flash-freezing all that it touches. The frost burns will never heal.
737475e8f5ab.dst: 這把弓射出的箭是純粹的冰，但一命中敵人便會炸成魔法之水，瞬間凍結所觸及的一切。那樣的凍傷永遠不會癒合。
737475e8f5ab.flat: Arrows fired by this bow are pure ice, but when they hit the enemy, burst into magical water, flash-freezing all that it touches. The frost burns will never heal.

2fadc7eb53f5.src: "The plants loathe to take hold upon the red stone. And so, we must hunt instead."  -Caras, Owl Tribesman
2fadc7eb53f5.dst: 「植物討厭在那片紅石上扎根。所以我們只好改用獵的。」—Caras，梟族族人
2fadc7eb53f5.flat: "The plants loathe to take hold upon the red stone. And so, we must hunt instead."  -Caras, Owl Tribesman

69e40540477e.src: The art of endurance fighting is a skill lost to time. However, a thief that to this day has not been caught, imbued this dagger with the very same ability.
69e40540477e.dst: 耐力戰的技藝早已失傳於時間之中。然而有個至今仍未落網的竊賊，把同樣的能力灌注進了這把匕首。
69e40540477e.flat: The art of endurance fighting is a skill lost to time. However, a thief that to this day has not been caught, imbued this dagger with the very same ability.

1ed698ab8fd9.src: "There's never new water flowing into those sewers. It all cycles back into itself...not natural." -Jenprest, {p} Legion {~}nd Division
1ed698ab8fd9.dst: 「那些下水道從來沒有新的水流進去。全都是自己循環回自己……不自然。」—Jenprest，{p} 軍團第 {~} 師
1ed698ab8fd9.flat: "There's never new water flowing into those sewers. It all cycles back into itself...not natural." -Jenprest, {p} Legion {~}nd Division
1ed698ab8fd9._raw: "There's never new water flowing into those sewers. It all cycles back into itself...not natural." -Jenprest, Ragni Legion 2nd Division

4845168fc2a8.src: From afar, a faint light glimmers. A brighter light next. Another. Then another still. A cascade of blinding force, more than anything you could have ever imagined. And then... nothing. As though there was never anything there.
4845168fc2a8.dst: 遠處，一點微光閃了一下。接著是更亮的一道。又一道。然後又一道。一場層層疊上的、令人目盲的力量，超過你所能想像的一切。然後……什麼都沒有了。彷彿那裡從來就不曾有過任何東西。
4845168fc2a8.flat: From afar, a faint light glimmers. A brighter light next. Another. Then another still. A cascade of blinding force, more than anything you could have ever imagined. And then... nothing. As though there was never anything there.

f36cc47f9035.src: Crafted exclusively by the Temple of the Legends' mages, this stave is honorary to Mages who best the Temple's Grand Magus.
f36cc47f9035.dst: 由傳說神殿的法師專門打造，這根長杖是頒給擊敗神殿大魔導師的法師的榮譽之物。
f36cc47f9035.flat: Crafted exclusively by the Temple of the Legends' mages, this stave is honorary to Mages who best the Temple's Grand Magus.

c8bb0065be6a.src: "I swear on my life those spiders were covered in spikes! Go out there, see if I'm wrong!" -Suri, Elemental Researcher
c8bb0065be6a.dst: 「我用我這條命發誓，那些蜘蛛全身都是刺！你自己出去看，看我說錯了沒！」—Suri，元素研究員
c8bb0065be6a.flat: "I swear on my life those spiders were covered in spikes! Go out there, see if I'm wrong!" -Suri, Elemental Researcher

2cd027e13ba4.src: If it weren't for that stray mark, this would be spelled correctly...
2cd027e13ba4.dst: 要不是多了那一筆，這名字本來是拼對的……
2cd027e13ba4.flat: If it weren't for that stray mark, this would be spelled correctly...

7d1b5e4ba72a.src: Do you ... really expect to be able to steal, or even touch, a single drop from that holiest-and cruelest-of springs?
7d1b5e4ba72a.dst: 你……真的以為自己能從那道最神聖、也最殘酷的泉裡，偷走、甚至只是碰到一滴嗎？
7d1b5e4ba72a.flat: Do you ... really expect to be able to steal, or even touch, a single drop from that holiest-and cruelest-of springs?

9103aa96583d.src: "Never wish to see a dead loved one again. In this day and age, they'll come back to see you." -Mylo, {p} Conscript
9103aa96583d.dst: 「千萬別許願再見到過世的親人。在這個年頭，他們真的會回來見你。」—Mylo，{p} 徵召兵
9103aa96583d.flat: "Never wish to see a dead loved one again. In this day and age, they'll come back to see you." -Mylo, {p} Conscript
9103aa96583d._raw: "Never wish to see a dead loved one again. In this day and age, they'll come back to see you." -Mylo, Nemract Conscript

cc167e73bfeb.src: Deep, deep below the swirling, suffocating muck and the things that slither and crawl in the dark, there is a pulse. A wild, churning, erratic pulse, beating ever so quickly to the tempo of the earth, waiting to be unleashed.
cc167e73bfeb.dst: 在翻攪、令人窒息的爛泥，以及那些在黑暗中滑行爬動的東西之下，很深、很深的地方，有一道脈搏。狂野、翻騰、紊亂的脈搏，隨著大地的節拍飛快跳動，等著被釋放出來。
cc167e73bfeb.flat: Deep, deep below the swirling, suffocating muck and the things that slither and crawl in the dark, there is a pulse. A wild, churning, erratic pulse, beating ever so quickly to the tempo of the earth, waiting to be unleashed.

96f582fd5035.src: Its frame is as that of a horrid maw, its arrows hideous tongues of stone. They reach out, pulling their victims into an acidic embrace. What are they searching, grasping for? Perhaps some questions are wiser to ignore.
96f582fd5035.dst: 它的框架宛如一張可怖的巨口，它的箭矢則是猙獰的石舌。它們伸出去，把受害者拉進一個酸蝕的擁抱。它們到底在找什麼、在抓什麼？有些問題，或許別去想比較明智。
96f582fd5035.flat: Its frame is as that of a horrid maw, its arrows hideous tongues of stone. They reach out, pulling their victims into an acidic embrace. What are they searching, grasping for? Perhaps some questions are wiser to ignore.

6f5f7b28384c.src: Once known as the Doomsday Weapon, it was ultimately never used for its intended purpose - its solar focus was cracked upon the day of its completion. All but a fraction of its energy was expelled, obliterating its creators, but overwhelming magical force still pulses and thrums through the web of fractures in its design.
6f5f7b28384c.dst: 它曾被稱為「末日兵器」，最終卻從未派上原本的用場——它的聚陽核心在完工當天就裂開了。除了一小部分之外，它的能量盡數逸出，把它的創造者們化為烏有；但那股龐大的魔力至今仍在它滿佈的裂痕之間搏動、嗡鳴。
6f5f7b28384c.flat: Once known as the Doomsday Weapon, it was ultimately never used for its intended purpose - its solar focus was cracked upon the day of its completion. All but a fraction of its energy was expelled, obliterating its creators, but overwhelming magical force still pulses and thrums through the web of fractures in its design.

4e835df2f426.src: An attempt to rule with an iron fist, a power hellbent on control and force.  Unknown. How far does the indomitable spirit of humanity extend?
4e835df2f426.dst: 一次以鐵腕統治的嘗試，一股一心要掌控與施壓的力量。未知。人類那不可屈服的精神，究竟能延伸到多遠？
4e835df2f426.flat: An attempt to rule with an iron fist, a power hellbent on control and force.  Unknown. How far does the indomitable spirit of humanity extend?

72687a012b76.src: No one can hold you down anymore.
72687a012b76.dst: 再也沒有人壓得住你了。
72687a012b76.flat: No one can hold you down anymore.

8c26329a38f8.src: The soul of a Devil is so hot with hatred that their  bodies melt like candle wax, coming off in molten globs of flesh until only black bones remain.
8c26329a38f8.dst: 惡魔的靈魂被憎恨燒得極燙，燙到他們的身體會像蠟一樣融化，一團團熔化的血肉剝落下來，直到只剩下一副黑色的骨骸。
8c26329a38f8.flat: The soul of a Devil is so hot with hatred that their  bodies melt like candle wax, coming off in molten globs of flesh until only black bones remain.

4fe9391a6e1b.src: You will probably irreversibly harm yourself with this, but when has that ever stopped you?
4fe9391a6e1b.dst: 你多半會用這東西把自己弄成無法復原的樣子，但那什麼時候攔住過你？
4fe9391a6e1b.flat: You will probably irreversibly harm yourself with this, but when has that ever stopped you?

50a985c2b3b6.src: This spear comes alive in your hands. It whispers strategy and technique to you, a voice that cuts through the clash of metal and screams of the dying. It is always correct. It has only ever lost a single battle. Do not let it down.
50a985c2b3b6.dst: 這桿長矛在你手裡活了過來。它對你低聲說著戰略與技巧，那個聲音穿透了金屬的撞擊與瀕死者的尖叫。它永遠是對的。它這輩子只輸過一場。別讓它失望。
50a985c2b3b6.flat: This spear comes alive in your hands. It whispers strategy and technique to you, a voice that cuts through the clash of metal and screams of the dying. It is always correct. It has only ever lost a single battle. Do not let it down.

40b1964af3e9.src: The stones have a language. You can learn to direct their shiftings and discover their names; all you must do in return is forget your own.
40b1964af3e9.dst: 石頭是有語言的。你可以學會指揮它們的移動、知曉它們的名字；你唯一要付出的，是忘掉你自己的。
40b1964af3e9.flat: The stones have a language. You can learn to direct their shiftings and discover their names; all you must do in return is forget your own.

a213d8b03c49.src: Presto. Like a viper's strike, retreating before the prey even feels the fang. A blade defined by a speed that leaves no memory of its passing.
a213d8b03c49.dst: 急板。如同毒蛇的一擊，在獵物還沒感覺到獠牙之前就已收回。一把由速度定義的刃，快到不留下任何經過的記憶。
a213d8b03c49.flat: Presto. Like a viper's strike, retreating before the prey even feels the fang. A blade defined by a speed that leaves no memory of its passing.

647abb50d11c.src: Moderato. Like the disciplined steps of a march, never skipping its appointed mark. A wand defined by a constancy that brings order to chaos.
647abb50d11c.dst: 中板。如同行軍中訓練有素的步伐，從不錯過既定的拍點。一根由恆定定義的魔杖，為混亂帶來秩序。
647abb50d11c.flat: Moderato. Like the disciplined steps of a march, never skipping its appointed mark. A wand defined by a constancy that brings order to chaos.

fdef278778a5.src: Adagio. Like the heavy hammer of a blacksmith, striking slow to shape tempered steel. A crossbow defined by the deliberate power of its draw.
fdef278778a5.dst: 慢板。如同鐵匠沉重的鎚，緩緩落下以塑出淬火的鋼。一把由拉弓時那份從容力量所定義的十字弓。
fdef278778a5.flat: Adagio. Like the heavy hammer of a blacksmith, striking slow to shape tempered steel. A crossbow defined by the deliberate power of its draw.

5e25cdef9087.src: Largo. Like the deep ocean tides governed by the moon, indifferent to the hurry of the world. A spear defined by a crushing momentum that nothing can halt.
5e25cdef9087.dst: 最緩板。如同受月亮支配的深海潮汐，對世界的匆忙毫不在意。一桿由無物能阻的碾壓動能所定義的矛。
5e25cdef9087.flat: Largo. Like the deep ocean tides governed by the moon, indifferent to the hurry of the world. A spear defined by a crushing momentum that nothing can halt.

9358483562b5.src: No eyes see past the dark fog that enshrouds the future. But if you could perhaps light the way, what would you see? Invigorating hope? Or a warning to be heeded?
9358483562b5.dst: 沒有任何眼睛看得穿籠罩未來的那片黑霧。但如果你真能照亮前路，你會看見什麼？令人振奮的希望？還是一則不得不聽的警告？
9358483562b5.flat: No eyes see past the dark fog that enshrouds the future. But if you could perhaps light the way, what would you see? Invigorating hope? Or a warning to be heeded?

87bce3ffb94a.src: I'm not touching this with a... well. Yeah.
87bce3ffb94a.dst: 這東西我連十尺長的竿子都不想拿去碰……嗯，對，就是這個意思。
87bce3ffb94a.flat: I'm not touching this with a... well. Yeah.

b124853e1178.src: The strength to keep going, to push on in the face of adversity. It's a rare kind of grit, the one that takes hold and won't let go until the task is done.
b124853e1178.dst: 那份繼續走下去、在逆境之中依然向前推進的力量。那是一種罕見的韌性——一旦咬住，任務不完成就絕不鬆口。
b124853e1178.flat: The strength to keep going, to push on in the face of adversity. It's a rare kind of grit, the one that takes hold and won't let go until the task is done.

cc130717f134.src: Don't give them time for even a warning.It's pulling towards something.
cc130717f134.dst: 連讓他們示警的時間都別給。它正被某種東西牽引著。
cc130717f134.flat: Don't give them time for even a warning.It's pulling towards something.

453ca59af40e.src: Forged from unbreakable obsidian eras ago, this heavy hammer has crushed many foes with a single swing.
453ca59af40e.dst: 在數個紀元之前以牢不可破的黑曜石鍛成，這柄沉重的鎚只需一揮就碾碎了無數敵人。
453ca59af40e.flat: Forged from unbreakable obsidian eras ago, this heavy hammer has crushed many foes with a single swing.

420d2b20d206.src: Once having held unstoppable amounts of magic, being forced to fuse into one form locked away all but the smallest sliver of their power.
420d2b20d206.dst: 它們原本蘊含著無可阻擋的龐大魔力，卻在被迫融合成單一形態之後，被鎖住了除最微小一絲之外的全部力量。
420d2b20d206.flat: Once having held unstoppable amounts of magic, being forced to fuse into one form locked away all but the smallest sliver of their power.

a921c90f36f1.src: "How perfect can a form be? The creatures here are warped. Distorted. their flesh bubbles and oozes with the most toxic of acids. But it makes them powerful. Resilient. Perhaps it would be better to become one of them. Perhaps it would make your form . . . perfect."
a921c90f36f1.dst: 「一個形體能有多完美？這裡的生物是扭曲的。變形的。牠們的血肉冒著泡、滲出最毒的酸。但那也讓牠們強大。堅韌。也許成為牠們的一員會更好。也許那會讓你的形體……變得完美。」
a921c90f36f1.flat: "How perfect can a form be? The creatures here are warped. Distorted. their flesh bubbles and oozes with the most toxic of acids. But it makes them powerful. Resilient. Perhaps it would be better to become one of them. Perhaps it would make your form . . . perfect."

764e6d47f03f.src: This indestructible dagger was found floating in the magma of the {p}, with a lament from its exiled smith carved onto the hilt.
764e6d47f03f.dst: 這把堅不可摧的匕首是在 {p} 的岩漿中漂浮時被找到的，劍柄上刻著它那位被流放的鑄匠所留下的哀嘆。
764e6d47f03f.flat: This indestructible dagger was found floating in the magma of the {p}, with a lament from its exiled smith carved onto the hilt.
764e6d47f03f._raw: This indestructible dagger was found floating in the magma of the Molten Heights, with a lament from its exiled smith carved onto the hilt.

68fe5b2ee110.src: "They tear the earth open day after day after day, ripping out her most precious and vital stones, and dumping them into the abyss of their hungry, bottomless coffers. They would sell out the world for a bit of cash; after all, these stones bleed green."
68fe5b2ee110.dst: 「他們日復一日、日復一日地把大地剖開，扯出她最珍貴、最要緊的石頭，再把它們倒進自己那飢餓而無底的金庫深淵裡。為了一點現金，他們願意把整個世界賣掉；畢竟，這些石頭流的是綠色的血。」
68fe5b2ee110.flat: "They tear the earth open day after day after day, ripping out her most precious and vital stones, and dumping them into the abyss of their hungry, bottomless coffers. They would sell out the world for a bit of cash; after all, these stones bleed green."

6777f0c823b5.src: "In the days before they ripped out its heart, there was a pulse to these streets: the sanguine flow of life through the sturdy buildings and cobbled roads and hidden alleys. What remains is a bloodless husk, dusty walls populated solely by those hideous things which can only see and never know."
6777f0c823b5.dst: 「在他們把它的心臟掏出來之前，這些街道是有脈搏的：那是生命在堅固的建築、鵝卵石路與隱密巷弄之間如血液般紅潤地流動。如今留下的是一具失血的空殼，積灰的牆間只住著那些只能看見、卻永遠無法理解的醜惡之物。」
6777f0c823b5.flat: "In the days before they ripped out its heart, there was a pulse to these streets: the sanguine flow of life through the sturdy buildings and cobbled roads and hidden alleys. What remains is a bloodless husk, dusty walls populated solely by those hideous things which can only see and never know."

e3c8bd490181.src: After eons spent in parochial search for something familiar, perhaps this blade should have been a hint to think outside the box.
e3c8bd490181.dst: 在無數個紀元裡狹隘地尋找某種熟悉的東西之後，這片刃或許早該提醒他們，該跳出框框想想了。
e3c8bd490181.flat: After eons spent in parochial search for something familiar, perhaps this blade should have been a hint to think outside the box.

345ccf85dcaa.src: The ocean's bounty is full of many strange things. Sailor's tales of a peculiar fish with a snout like a sword and the unbelievable stories of its power thus inspired fanciful ideas in blacksmiths. The results speak for themselves.
345ccf85dcaa.dst: 海洋的饋贈裡有許多奇異之物。水手們口耳相傳一種吻部像劍的怪魚，以及關於牠力量那些難以置信的故事，因而在鐵匠心中激起了種種奇想。成果如何，它自己會說話。
345ccf85dcaa.flat: The ocean's bounty is full of many strange things. Sailor's tales of a peculiar fish with a snout like a sword and the unbelievable stories of its power thus inspired fanciful ideas in blacksmiths. The results speak for themselves.

67728572596d.src: "The feeling begins as a prickle on the neck. Is that tree staring? What does it see? How much does it know? This place is not right. It sees too much. It knows too much. The forest is staring at you. It burns the secrets out of you through its awful, unnatural retinas. There is nowhere to hide."
67728572596d.dst: 「那感覺一開始是脖子上的一陣刺癢。那棵樹是在盯著看嗎？它看見了什麼？它知道多少？這個地方不對勁。它看得太多了。它知道得太多了。這座森林正在盯著你。它用那些可怕而不自然的視網膜，把祕密從你身上灼出來。無處可躲。」
67728572596d.flat: "The feeling begins as a prickle on the neck. Is that tree staring? What does it see? How much does it know? This place is not right. It sees too much. It knows too much. The forest is staring at you. It burns the secrets out of you through its awful, unnatural retinas. There is nowhere to hide."

614544d0cd31.src: "And no one's going to save us from the beasts about to strike. We've seen horrors stare us in the eyes, and we're fighting for our lives." -Poe, {p} Sewer Dweller
614544d0cd31.dst: 「而且沒有人會來救我們，那些野獸就要撲上來了。我們見過恐怖直視我們的眼睛，而我們正在為性命而戰。」—Poe，{p} 下水道住民
614544d0cd31.flat: "And no one's going to save us from the beasts about to strike. We've seen horrors stare us in the eyes, and we're fighting for our lives." -Poe, {p} Sewer Dweller
614544d0cd31._raw: "And no one's going to save us from the beasts about to strike. We've seen horrors stare us in the eyes, and we're fighting for our lives." -Poe, Nemract Sewer Dweller

051e79e1ea42.src: Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and consuming fury combine to create a deadly aura, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for utter cataclysm.
051e79e1ea42.dst: 銘刻的 Uth 符文之力與吞噬一切的狂怒交融，形成一股致命的氣場；這件武器不過是使用者「徹底浩劫」這份意志在現實中的延伸。
051e79e1ea42.flat: Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and consuming fury combine to create a deadly aura, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for utter cataclysm.
