99afe5479b0b.src: The raw aspect of thunder, though claimed to be harnessed by a mage in a wand, has only been truly tamed by this mighty blade. Combined electric and life-draining magic intertwine and bring forth the truest, most frightening power of all Thunder.
99afe5479b0b.dst: 雷霆最原始的那一面，儘管曾有法師聲稱已將它收進一根魔杖裡，真正被馴服卻是在這柄強悍的刃上。電擊與吸取生命的魔法在此交纏，召喚出全體雷霆之中最真實、也最令人膽寒的力量。
99afe5479b0b.flat: The raw aspect of thunder, though claimed to be harnessed by a mage in a wand, has only been truly tamed by this mighty blade. Combined electric and life-draining magic intertwine and bring forth the truest, most frightening power of all Thunder.

8b0e9b5a589f.src: This bow has no string. Instead, a thin lightning-like thread is strung upon it. It is said to be limited only by the speed of the user.
8b0e9b5a589f.dst: 這把弓沒有弦。取而代之的是一條細如閃電的絲線。據說它唯一的限制就是使用者的速度。
8b0e9b5a589f.flat: This bow has no string. Instead, a thin lightning-like thread is strung upon it. It is said to be limited only by the speed of the user.

d1c4c2c9c960.src: This mysterious, half-liquid trident apparently holds the secret magics to control the ocean's ebb and flow. It is incapable of touching solid ground.
d1c4c2c9c960.dst: 這柄神祕的半液態三叉戟，據說掌握著操縱海洋潮汐漲落的祕法。它無法碰觸堅實的地面。
d1c4c2c9c960.flat: This mysterious, half-liquid trident apparently holds the secret magics to control the ocean's ebb and flow. It is incapable of touching solid ground.

74b5a41c6931.src: The wear upon this broken old battle spear does not affect its ability in battle. The souls of a thousand fallen warriors resound within it.
74b5a41c6931.dst: 這桿殘破舊戰矛上的磨損，絲毫不影響它在戰鬥中的能耐。千名戰死者的靈魂在它之中迴響。
74b5a41c6931.flat: The wear upon this broken old battle spear does not affect its ability in battle. The souls of a thousand fallen warriors resound within it.

aad0f6136511.src: This peculiar weapon was once wielded by the firey warrior Igbar, who used it to great effect in endurance competitions.
aad0f6136511.dst: 這件古怪的武器曾由火焰戰士 Igbar 所持，他靠它在耐力競賽中大放異彩。
aad0f6136511.flat: This peculiar weapon was once wielded by the firey warrior Igbar, who used it to great effect in endurance competitions.

349a6283e055.src: The tides of the ocean, once bound, became useful magic power sources. They were once utilized for weapons, but to harness the unstable force of the raging sea was considered too dangerous.
349a6283e055.dst: 海洋的潮汐一旦被縛住，就成了好用的魔力來源。它們曾被用於武器，但駕馭怒海那股不穩定的力量被認為實在太危險了。
349a6283e055.flat: The tides of the ocean, once bound, became useful magic power sources. They were once utilized for weapons, but to harness the unstable force of the raging sea was considered too dangerous.

6385bfc67866.src: A hissing, cracking harmony swells, a maddening chorus to blare across the broken plains, yet still: unseen and alive, it swells with the beat of the earth, still breathing, still killing.
6385bfc67866.dst: 一段嘶嘶作響、劈啪碎裂的和聲逐漸高漲，化作一支令人發狂的合唱響徹破碎的平原；然而它依舊：無形而活著，隨著大地的節拍膨脹，仍在呼吸，仍在殺戮。
6385bfc67866.flat: A hissing, cracking harmony swells, a maddening chorus to blare across the broken plains, yet still: unseen and alive, it swells with the beat of the earth, still breathing, still killing.

a58b7720a3cd.src: Can you feel the burning inside? Something has made itself at home. Time to tuck away the parts of you it has no need for, to shuffle your little brain around so you may Carry. Carry and Spread. Give it a new home-melting you down is how it says thank you. Be grateful, won't you?
a58b7720a3cd.dst: 你感覺到裡面在燒了嗎？有東西住進來了。該把你身上它用不到的部分收一收了，把你那顆小小的腦子挪一挪，好讓你能夠「攜帶」。攜帶，然後散播。給它一個新家吧——把你融掉，就是它道謝的方式。要心懷感激，好嗎？
a58b7720a3cd.flat: Can you feel the burning inside? Something has made itself at home. Time to tuck away the parts of you it has no need for, to shuffle your little brain around so you may Carry. Carry and Spread. Give it a new home-melting you down is how it says thank you. Be grateful, won't you?

18c65816423a.src: Down. Your enemies will fall slack. Deeper. Do you know this compulsion you bring? Deeper still. This implement, reaching from within and without. Even deeper. Souls and wills to command at the flex of a finger. Almost gone. It is my compulsion, too great to ignore. It is my implement, too strong to resist. My puppets, too deep to escape. Drop.
18c65816423a.dst: 往下。你的敵人會鬆懈下來。再深一點。你知道自己帶來的這股強迫嗎？再更深一點。這件器物，從內在與外在同時伸手過來。再深一點。靈魂與意志，動一動手指便可差遣。快要沒了。這是我的強迫，強烈到無法忽視。這是我的器物，強大到無從抗拒。我的傀儡們，已經深到逃不出來了。落下。
18c65816423a.flat: Down. Your enemies will fall slack. Deeper. Do you know this compulsion you bring? Deeper still. This implement, reaching from within and without. Even deeper. Souls and wills to command at the flex of a finger. Almost gone. It is my compulsion, too great to ignore. It is my implement, too strong to resist. My puppets, too deep to escape. Drop.

bd80aca80030.src: Desperation breeds creativity. What would it take to force your will upon the world? To bend and break and weave existence, to bypass the immutable? The result is different, wrong, anathema to your being... but it is freedom from the chains that bind you. It is enough.
bd80aca80030.dst: 絕境會逼出創造力。要把你的意志強加於世界，得付出什麼？要折彎、要打碎、要重新編織存在，要繞過那些不可更動的規則，又得付出什麼？結果是不一樣的、是錯的、是與你的本質相牴觸的……但那是從捆住你的鎖鏈中掙得的自由。這樣就夠了。
bd80aca80030.flat: Desperation breeds creativity. What would it take to force your will upon the world? To bend and break and weave existence, to bypass the immutable? The result is different, wrong, anathema to your being... but it is freedom from the chains that bind you. It is enough.

428ca71f9ef6.src: "It feels like all these "ancient" civilizations have better tech than we do nowadays."  -Knox, Corkus Immigrant and Sandstorm Vandals bandit
428ca71f9ef6.dst: 「感覺這些所謂的『古』文明，科技都比我們現在還好。」—Knox，Corkus 移民，沙暴破壞者強盜團成員
428ca71f9ef6.flat: "It feels like all these "ancient" civilizations have better tech than we do nowadays."  -Knox, Corkus Immigrant and Sandstorm Vandals bandit

4b172919efae.src: Truth, bliss, emanation, guiding the path forward unto enlightenment.
4b172919efae.dst: 真實、極樂、化現，引著前方的道路通往開悟。
4b172919efae.flat: Truth, bliss, emanation, guiding the path forward unto enlightenment.

1defa9881cf1.src: The hands of destiny tighten and slacken without remorse, pulling hearts together only to push them apart in a relentless dance.
1defa9881cf1.dst: 命運之手毫無悔意地收緊又放鬆，把心拉到一起，只為了在一場不停歇的舞裡再把它們推開。
1defa9881cf1.flat: The hands of destiny tighten and slacken without remorse, pulling hearts together only to push them apart in a relentless dance.

2e4dbd2048a3.src: It takes two voices to make harmony.
2e4dbd2048a3.dst: 要有兩個聲音，才成得了和聲。
2e4dbd2048a3.flat: It takes two voices to make harmony.

9561baabdcca.src: To drag into shadow. To stifle in darkness. Anything is possible with total, suffocating eclipse at your beck and call.
9561baabdcca.dst: 拖進陰影。悶死於黑暗。當一場徹底而令人窒息的日蝕任你差遣時，沒有什麼是不可能的。
9561baabdcca.flat: To drag into shadow. To stifle in darkness. Anything is possible with total, suffocating eclipse at your beck and call.

f95fd4bca528.src: Sometimes, wavers in the light reveal visions of fantastical places.  A window or portal rippled into existence for just a moment, then winked out by a breeze.
f95fd4bca528.dst: 有時候，光線的搖曳會顯露出奇幻之地的景象。一扇窗、或一道門，就這樣漣漪般存在了短短一瞬，接著又被一陣風眨掉了。
f95fd4bca528.flat: Sometimes, wavers in the light reveal visions of fantastical places.  A window or portal rippled into existence for just a moment, then winked out by a breeze.

a20d87d24aa4.src: It seems stronger at first glance, but upon closer inspection the blade is rather...soft?
a20d87d24aa4.dst: 乍看之下好像變強了，不過仔細一看，這刀身……有點軟？
a20d87d24aa4.flat: It seems stronger at first glance, but upon closer inspection the blade is rather...soft?

a57f7c0f7b3a.src: "{~} curse-free or your money back!" The merchant explained that this policy is not legally binding after you read it.
a57f7c0f7b3a.dst: 「保證 {~} 沒有詛咒，否則退錢！」你讀完之後，商人解釋說這條政策不具法律效力。
a57f7c0f7b3a.flat: "{~} curse-free or your money back!" The merchant explained that this policy is not legally binding after you read it.
a57f7c0f7b3a._raw: "100% curse-free or your money back!" The merchant explained that this policy is not legally binding after you read it.

0e716d67a725.src: The magic in this wand seems much weaker than normal...and there's a rather rude message written on the handle.
0e716d67a725.dst: 這根魔杖裡的魔力似乎比一般的弱得多……而且握柄上寫著一句相當沒禮貌的話。
0e716d67a725.flat: The magic in this wand seems much weaker than normal...and there's a rather rude message written on the handle.

97b49d1a4604.src: Did the merchant really think that adding severed bat wings to the weapon would make it more authentic?
97b49d1a4604.dst: 商人真的以為在武器上黏幾片割下來的蝙蝠翅膀，會讓它更「正宗」嗎？
97b49d1a4604.flat: Did the merchant really think that adding severed bat wings to the weapon would make it more authentic?

8d0fbaa79774.src: The weapon nearly catches fire during the merchant's demonstration. He still refuses to discount it despite this.
8d0fbaa79774.dst: 商人示範的時候，這武器差點自己燒起來。即便如此他還是不肯降價。
8d0fbaa79774.flat: The weapon nearly catches fire during the merchant's demonstration. He still refuses to discount it despite this.

280df99df79a.src: The blade is covered in tape that's been scribbled on in order to make it look fiery. This doesn't seem like a wise purchase.
280df99df79a.dst: 刀身上纏著膠帶，上面亂塗一通想弄出火焰的樣子。這看起來不像是明智的採購。
280df99df79a.flat: The blade is covered in tape that's been scribbled on in order to make it look fiery. This doesn't seem like a wise purchase.

c093b918dee9.src: Apparently, they thought to make a long bow better, they should make it longer. You can barely hold it.
c093b918dee9.dst: 看樣子他們認為要讓長弓變好，就得讓它更長。你幾乎握不住它。
c093b918dee9.flat: Apparently, they thought to make a long bow better, they should make it longer. You can barely hold it.

633347d2ee95.src: The inscribed lyrics have been scratched out and replaced with a barely-legible insult.
633347d2ee95.dst: 刻在上面的歌詞被刮掉了，換成一句幾乎看不清楚的辱罵。
633347d2ee95.flat: The inscribed lyrics have been scratched out and replaced with a barely-legible insult.

8439f391882b.src: There are parts from at least six separately recognizable weapons mashed together to make this. There's no way it's effective.
8439f391882b.dst: 這東西是用至少六件還認得出來的不同武器拼湊起來的。它不可能有用。
8439f391882b.flat: There are parts from at least six separately recognizable weapons mashed together to make this. There's no way it's effective.

e48c8dd44113.src: According to the merchant, the wand is extra flammable, so that it can burn up and disappear with all the mages quicker.
e48c8dd44113.dst: 照商人的說法，這根魔杖特別易燃，這樣它就能連同法師一起燒掉、消失得更快。
e48c8dd44113.flat: According to the merchant, the wand is extra flammable, so that it can burn up and disappear with all the mages quicker.

fb1295760c61.src: The craftsmanship on this bow is rather poor. The paint on the "crystals" is chipping...
fb1295760c61.dst: 這把弓的做工相當粗糙。那些「水晶」上的漆都在剝落了……
fb1295760c61.flat: The craftsmanship on this bow is rather poor. The paint on the "crystals" is chipping...

38f8eeb199ca.src: The blade actually looks to be of good quality, unlike the other products. The only problem is the questionable stain covering most of it.
38f8eeb199ca.dst: 這刀身看起來品質倒是不錯，跟其他商品不一樣。唯一的問題是上面大半都蓋著一片可疑的汙漬。
38f8eeb199ca.flat: The blade actually looks to be of good quality, unlike the other products. The only problem is the questionable stain covering most of it.

d27f6191f679.src: It is significantly heavier than usual...you can't tell if that is good or not, in this case.
d27f6191f679.dst: 它比一般的重上不少……在這個情況下，你也說不準這算不算好事。
d27f6191f679.flat: It is significantly heavier than usual...you can't tell if that is good or not, in this case.

9bea5f989dd6.src: The guard on the spear is smaller, but at least twice as thick. What purpose does that have?
9bea5f989dd6.dst: 這桿矛的護手變小了，但厚度至少是原本的兩倍。這到底有什麼用？
9bea5f989dd6.flat: The guard on the spear is smaller, but at least twice as thick. What purpose does that have?

370906f2eb3e.src: The blade seems sharper than normal, but it also seems rather brittle. The smithing was obviously a hack-job...
370906f2eb3e.dst: 刀身看起來比一般的鋒利，卻也顯得相當脆。鍛造顯然是隨便亂搞的……
370906f2eb3e.flat: The blade seems sharper than normal, but it also seems rather brittle. The smithing was obviously a hack-job...

8a7e8b499b2e.src: A strength fueled by rage, merciless, unending. A hatred, all-consuming, that erodes all other thought, all sense of being. An ally so fickle, so selfish, that leaves you aimless at the moment of pyrrhic triumph.
8a7e8b499b2e.dst: 一股由憤怒餵養的力量，毫不留情，永無止境。一種吞噬一切的憎恨，把其餘所有思緒、所有存在感都侵蝕殆盡。那是個反覆無常又自私的盟友——當你贏得那場慘勝的瞬間，它會留下你一個人，無所適從。
8a7e8b499b2e.flat: A strength fueled by rage, merciless, unending. A hatred, all-consuming, that erodes all other thought, all sense of being. An ally so fickle, so selfish, that leaves you aimless at the moment of pyrrhic triumph.

c3e644241600.src: The carving on this timeworn staff writes: Hisel Acetlrif
c3e644241600.dst: 這根飽經歲月的長杖上刻著：Hisel Acetlrif
c3e644241600.flat: The carving on this timeworn staff writes: Hisel Acetlrif

47b4005e09d5.src: An attempt to discover opulence in stone; greed-fueled destruction and avaricious growth. Too far. Chaos was brought into the world, and greed begat death.
47b4005e09d5.dst: 一次在石頭中尋找富貴的嘗試；由貪婪驅動的破壞，與貪得無厭的增長。走得太遠了。混亂被帶進了這個世界，而貪婪生出了死亡。
47b4005e09d5.flat: An attempt to discover opulence in stone; greed-fueled destruction and avaricious growth. Too far. Chaos was brought into the world, and greed begat death.

7ef2fda6775a.dst: 內臟，向外。它正被某種東西牽引著。

ca9d89caa616.src: To look and say "I will go there," and to keep going until you find it...that's what's important.
ca9d89caa616.dst: 望過去說一句「我要去那裡」，然後一直走到找到為止……重要的是這個。
ca9d89caa616.flat: To look and say "I will go there," and to keep going until you find it...that's what's important.

4ce607a7ef90.src: "I've been wishin' I was dead for a long time."
4ce607a7ef90.dst: 「我盼著自己死掉，已經盼了很久了。」
4ce607a7ef90.flat: "I've been wishin' I was dead for a long time."

a89cbfec40c5.src: The notorious and erratic magical inventor Gawrick once attempted to make teleportation scrolls obsolete, by creating items which would allow the user to phase into an ethereal state to move unhindered. He did not account for the physical ramifications of this process, however.
a89cbfec40c5.dst: 那位聲名狼藉、行事乖張的魔法發明家 Gawrick，曾試圖讓傳送捲軸就此淘汰：他要造出一種能讓使用者進入靈體狀態、暢行無阻的器物。只是他沒把這個過程對肉體的後果算進去。
a89cbfec40c5.flat: The notorious and erratic magical inventor Gawrick once attempted to make teleportation scrolls obsolete, by creating items which would allow the user to phase into an ethereal state to move unhindered. He did not account for the physical ramifications of this process, however.

e8ff39cb6263.src: The mystery of the ocean's appearance has eluded scholars for centuries. It is believed that many years ago, warlocks used wands like this one in an attempt to submerge the world.
e8ff39cb6263.dst: 海洋究竟從何而來，這個謎題困擾學者數百年之久。一般相信在許多年前，術士們曾用像這樣的魔杖試圖把整個世界沉入水中。
e8ff39cb6263.flat: The mystery of the ocean's appearance has eluded scholars for centuries. It is believed that many years ago, warlocks used wands like this one in an attempt to submerge the world.

a6583b4fc976.src: A relic of the past in {p} was weathered down to a dagger by the sheer power of the wind. When used in battle, mysterious intertwined wind and time magic give it no physical presence.
a6583b4fc976.dst: {p} 的一件遠古遺物，被純粹的風力磨蝕成了一把匕首。用於戰鬥時，交纏的風與時間魔法會讓它失去一切實體。
a6583b4fc976.flat: A relic of the past in {p} was weathered down to a dagger by the sheer power of the wind. When used in battle, mysterious intertwined wind and time magic give it no physical presence.
a6583b4fc976._raw: A relic of the past in Time Valley was weathered down to a dagger by the sheer power of the wind. When used in battle, mysterious intertwined wind and time magic give it no physical presence.

c9bfac9b7ce0.src: "And you thought walking into a cobweb was bad." -Ope, {p} Botanist
c9bfac9b7ce0.dst: 「你還覺得走進蜘蛛網很慘呢。」—Ope，{p} 植物學家
c9bfac9b7ce0.flat: "And you thought walking into a cobweb was bad." -Ope, {p} Botanist
c9bfac9b7ce0._raw: "And you thought walking into a cobweb was bad." -Ope, Ragni Botanist

1b2dbfca0570.src: Warning - device in state of extreme disrepair. Operators may experience unstable output, resulting in severe heat production upsurges. Any damage to material will not be reimbursed, and users will not be compensated for any injuries, burns, or deaths caused by improper use.
1b2dbfca0570.dst: 警告——本裝置處於嚴重失修狀態。操作者可能遭遇輸出不穩，導致產熱急遽飆升。物料之任何損壞概不賠償，因不當使用所致之任何傷害、燒傷或死亡，亦不予補償。
1b2dbfca0570.flat: Warning - device in state of extreme disrepair. Operators may experience unstable output, resulting in severe heat production upsurges. Any damage to material will not be reimbursed, and users will not be compensated for any injuries, burns, or deaths caused by improper use.

d2e8b127009a.src: Wielded by the master of the Decrepit Sewers Dungeon, the arrows of this bow causes the target's body to slowly wither away.
d2e8b127009a.dst: 由破敗下水道地城的主宰所持，這把弓射出的箭會讓目標的身體逐漸枯萎凋零。
d2e8b127009a.flat: Wielded by the master of the Decrepit Sewers Dungeon, the arrows of this bow causes the target's body to slowly wither away.

755c46abcc69.src: Even reduced to just the bones, you can't help but feel bad for the poor thing this paw came from.
755c46abcc69.dst: 就算只剩下骨頭，你還是忍不住替這隻爪子的原主人感到難過。
755c46abcc69.flat: Even reduced to just the bones, you can't help but feel bad for the poor thing this paw came from.

be63c9f72e7b.src: Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and sheer rage intertwine to create a fearsome sight, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for total destruction.
be63c9f72e7b.dst: 銘刻的 Uth 符文之力與純粹的狂怒交纏，形成一幅駭人的景象；這件武器不過是使用者「全面毀滅」這份意志在現實中的延伸。
be63c9f72e7b.flat: Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and sheer rage intertwine to create a fearsome sight, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for total destruction.

cb855e1d87f7.src: The unstable power within this bow is capable of great destruction, but seems to zero out at the most crucial moments in battle. Only the most skillful archers can wield this weapon with confidence.
cb855e1d87f7.dst: 這把弓裡不穩定的力量足以造成巨大的破壞，卻似乎總在戰鬥最關鍵的時刻歸零。唯有技藝最高超的弓手，才能有把握地駕馭這件武器。
cb855e1d87f7.flat: The unstable power within this bow is capable of great destruction, but seems to zero out at the most crucial moments in battle. Only the most skillful archers can wield this weapon with confidence.
